  never comes back, so it says `'0'`.

### `lib/returns.ts` (new): the parts without React

```ts
import {
  compareMoney,
  compareQuantity,
  CREDIT_NOTE_REASONS,
  type CreditNoteLine,
  type CreditNoteLineFormValues,
  type CreditNoteSummary,
  defaultLineDescription,
  type DeliveryLine,
  type InvoiceLine,
  isZeroQuantity,
  plainQuantity,
  priceInUnit,
  prorateMoney,
  type ReceiptSummary,
  type RefundSourceType,
  RETURN_REASONS,
  type SalesReturn,
  type SalesReturnLine,
  type SalesReturnLineFormValues,
  subtractMoney,
  subtractQuantity,
  unappliedOf,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';

import { formDiscount } from './sales';

// The pure parts of the sales return, credit note and refund pages (step 15d), unit-tested in
// returns.spec.ts like lib/invoices.ts.

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sales returns

// A reason's key in the words. The API sends the reason as a plain string (the rule of every list
// the server may grow): one this app does not know yet reads "Other", never a raw key.
export function returnReasonKey(reason: string) {
  const known = RETURN_REASONS.find((item) => item === reason) ?? 'other';
  return `salesReturns.reasons.${known}` as const;
}

export function creditReasonKey(reason: string) {
  const known = CREDIT_NOTE_REASONS.find((item) => item === reason) ?? 'other';
  return `creditNotes.reasons.${known}` as const;
}

// What can still come back on a challan line, in the base unit: what left, less what posted
// returns brought back already. The API refuses more (return_over_delivered).
export function leftToReturn(
  line: Pick<DeliveryLine, 'baseQuantity' | 'returnedQuantity'>,
): string {
  return subtractQuantity(line.baseQuantity, line.returnedQuantity);
}

// The lines of a challan a return may still take back: something left, and not on the form
// already (a challan line once per return: return_line_twice)
export function returnableLines(
  lines: readonly DeliveryLine[],
  onForm: ReadonlySet<string>,
): DeliveryLine[] {
  return lines.filter(
    (line) => compareQuantity(line.returnedQuantity, line.baseQuantity) < 0 && !onForm.has(line.id),
  );
}

// A challan line as a return line, with everything that can still come back. Nothing came back
// yet: the challan's own unit and quantity, and its serial numbers. Some did: the base unit with
// what is left, and no serial numbers, because the line does not say which ones are still out
// there; the store keeper types the numbers on the goods. The batch stays empty: the server takes
// the challan line's own (return_batch_not_allowed otherwise).
export function challanLineToReturn(line: DeliveryLine): SalesReturnLineFormValues {
  const whole = isZeroQuantity(line.returnedQuantity);
  return {
    variantId: line.variantId,
    unitId: whole ? line.unitId : line.baseUnitId,
    quantity: plainQuantity(whole ? line.quantity : leftToReturn(line)),
    batchId: '',
    serialNumbers: whole ? line.serialNumbers : [],
    deliveryLineId: line.id,
  };
}

// A saved draft's line as the form holds it. A challan line names no batch (the API sent the
// challan's batch for the page; the contract refuses it on such a line).
export function toReturnFormLine(line: SalesReturnLine): SalesReturnLineFormValues {
  return {
    variantId: line.variantId,
    unitId: line.unitId,
    quantity: plainQuantity(line.quantity),
    batchId: line.deliveryLineId === null ? (line.batchId ?? '') : '',
    serialNumbers: line.serialNumbers,
    deliveryLineId: line.deliveryLineId ?? '',
  };
}

// What credit notes have not given the money back for yet, in the base unit. Only a billed line
// has money to give back: an unbilled one made the invoice smaller instead.
export function leftToCreditOf(line: SalesReturnLine): string {
  return line.invoiceLineId === null
    ? '0'
    : subtractQuantity(line.baseQuantity, line.creditedQuantity);
}

// The return lines a credit note for this invoice can still give the money back for: billed on
// this invoice, not all credited, and not on the form already (credit_note_return_twice)
export function creditableReturnLines(
  salesReturn: Pick<SalesReturn, 'lines'>,
  invoiceId: string,
  onForm: ReadonlySet<string>,
): SalesReturnLine[] {
  return salesReturn.lines.filter(
    (line) =>
      line.invoiceId === invoiceId && !isZeroQuantity(leftToCreditOf(line)) && !onForm.has(line.id),
  );
}

// The invoice "Write credit note" on a return starts with: the first one with billed goods that
// are not all credited. A return can hold lines of two invoices; a credit note is for one, so the
// button stays until both are credited.
export function firstCreditableInvoice(salesReturn: Pick<SalesReturn, 'lines'>): string | null {
  return (
    salesReturn.lines.find(
      (line) => line.invoiceId !== null && !isZeroQuantity(leftToCreditOf(line)),
    )?.invoiceId ?? null
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Credit notes

// What an invoice line can still give back: its total, less what posted credit notes took. The
// money cap of 15d.1 (credit_note_over_line).
export function creditLeft(line: Pick<InvoiceLine, 'total' | 'credited'>): string {
  return subtractMoney(line.total, line.credited);
}

// A unit's size in the base unit: "1" for the base unit itself
function factorOf(
  item: { baseUnitId: string; units: readonly { unitId: string; factor: string }[] },
  unitId: string,
): string {
  if (unitId === item.baseUnitId) return '1';
  const pack = item.units.find((unit) => unit.unitId === unitId);
  if (pack === undefined) throw new Error(`The product has no unit ${unitId}`);
  return pack.factor;
}

// The price of an invoice line moved to another unit of its item: ৳504 a case is ৳21 a piece
export function priceIn(
  line: Pick<InvoiceLine, 'unitPrice' | 'unitId' | 'baseUnitId' | 'units'>,
  unitId: string,
): string {
  return priceInUnit(line.unitPrice, factorOf(line, line.unitId), factorOf(line, unitId));
}

// A return line as a credit note line: the goods that came back, at the price the invoice line
// charged. Nothing credited yet: the return's own unit and quantity. Some was: the base unit with
// what is left. An amount discount goes with the share of the invoice line that came back, like an
// order's discount on a challan line (15c).
export function returnLineToCredit(
  returnLine: SalesReturnLine,
  invoiceLine: InvoiceLine,
): CreditNoteLineFormValues {
  const whole = isZeroQuantity(returnLine.creditedQuantity);
  const unitId = whole ? returnLine.unitId : returnLine.baseUnitId;
  const left = leftToCreditOf(returnLine);
  return {
    invoiceLineId: invoiceLine.id,
    returnLineId: returnLine.id,
    unitId,
    quantity: plainQuantity(whole ? returnLine.quantity : left),
    description:
      invoiceLine.description === defaultLineDescription(invoiceLine)
        ? ''
        : invoiceLine.description,
    unitPrice: priceIn(invoiceLine, unitId),
    discountType: invoiceLine.discountType,
    discount: formDiscount(
      invoiceLine.discountType === 'percent'
        ? invoiceLine.discount
        : prorateMoney(invoiceLine.discount, left, invoiceLine.baseQuantity),
    ),
  };
}

// A credit note line from the API as the form holds it (the toFormLine() of 15b, without the item
// and the VAT rate: both are the invoice line's)
export function toCreditFormLine(
  line: Pick<
    CreditNoteLine,
    | 'invoiceLineId'
    | 'returnLineId'
    | 'unitId'
    | 'quantity'
    | 'description'
    | 'productName'
    | 'optionValues'
    | 'unitPrice'
    | 'discountType'
    | 'discount'
  >,
): CreditNoteLineFormValues {
  return {
    invoiceLineId: line.invoiceLineId,
    returnLineId: line.returnLineId ?? '',
    unitId: line.unitId,
    quantity: plainQuantity(line.quantity),
    description: line.description === defaultLineDescription(line) ? '' : line.description,
    unitPrice: line.unitPrice,
    discountType: line.discountType,
    discount: formDiscount(line.discount),
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Refunds

// A place money can be paid back from: a receipt's or a posted credit note's money that is not
// applied to an invoice and not paid back yet (unappliedOf)
export interface RefundSourceOption {
  type: RefundSourceType;
  id: string;
  number: string;
  date: string;
  // Where the refund starts: the branch the money came in at
  branchId: string;
  left: string;
}

// The customer's posted receipts and credit notes with money left, the oldest first: an advance
// that waited longest is usually the one paid back. A voided receipt and a draft credit note hold
// no money.
export function refundSourcesOf(
  receipts: readonly ReceiptSummary[],
  creditNotes: readonly CreditNoteSummary[],
): RefundSourceOption[] {
  const fromReceipts = receipts
    .filter((receipt) => receipt.status === 'posted')
    .map((receipt): RefundSourceOption => ({
      type: 'receipt',
      id: receipt.id,
      number: receipt.number,
      date: receipt.date,
      branchId: receipt.branchId,
      left: unappliedOf(receipt),
    }));
  const fromCreditNotes = creditNotes.flatMap((note): RefundSourceOption[] =>
    note.status === 'posted' && note.number !== null
      ? [
          {
            type: 'credit_note',
            id: note.id,
            number: note.number,
            date: note.date,
            branchId: note.branchId,
            left: unappliedOf({
              amount: note.total,
              applied: note.applied,
              refunded: note.refunded,
            }),
          },
        ]
      : [],
  );
  return [...fromReceipts, ...fromCreditNotes]
    .filter((source) => compareMoney(source.left, '0') > 0)
    .toSorted((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.number.localeCompare(b.number));
}

// The form's one select for two boxes: "receipt:<id>" or "credit_note:<id>"
export function sourceKeyOf(source: { type: RefundSourceType; id: string }): string {
  return `${source.type}:${source.id}`;
}

// The two boxes the API wants from the select's value ('' for none)
export function sourceFields(key: string): { receiptId: string; creditNoteId: string } {
  const [type, id = ''] = key.split(':');
  return {
    receiptId: type === 'receipt' ? id : '',
    creditNoteId: type === 'credit_note' ? id : '',
  };
}
```

- **Pure functions in their own file**, like `lib/invoices.ts`: `returns.spec.ts` tests them without a browser,
  and the return form, the credit note form and page, and the refund form share them.
- **`returnReasonKey()` and `creditReasonKey()`.** The API sends a reason as a plain string, the rule of every list
  the server may grow (15d.1). A newer server's new reason must not show as a raw key like
  `salesReturns.reasons.recalled`; it reads "Other" until this app knows it. The lists, the pages and the printed
  sheets all use these two, so they never disagree.
- **Returns:**
  - **`leftToReturn()`** is what can still come back on a challan line: what left less what posted returns brought
    back. It is the same formula as `billableQuantity()`, but it means something else: after the line is billed,
    goods can still come back, while nothing more is billed. Two names keep the two questions apart.
  - **`returnableLines()`** leaves out what all came back and what is on the form already. A challan line is on a
    return once (`return_line_twice`, 15d.1).
  - **`challanLineToReturn()`** offers everything that can still come back. With nothing back yet, that is the
    challan's own unit, quantity and serial numbers: the common case of a whole line sent back. With some back
    already, it is the base unit with what is left, and no serial numbers: the line does not say which numbers are
    still out there, so the store keeper types the numbers on the goods in hand. Guessing would send numbers that
    are not in the box, and the server would refuse them (`return_serial_invalid`).
  - **The batch is always empty on a challan line.** The goods come back in the challan line's own batch, and the
    contract refuses one on such a line (`return_batch_not_allowed`).
  - **`toReturnFormLine()`** turns a saved draft's line back into the form's. The API sends the challan's batch on
    a challan line (for the page and the print), so it is dropped here, for the same reason.
- **Credit notes:**
  - **`leftToCreditOf()`** is what of a return line credit notes have not given the money back for yet. A line that
    was not billed has nothing to give back (15d.1: the invoice billed less instead), so it is `'0'`.
  - **`creditableReturnLines()`** keeps the return lines this invoice billed with something left to credit, and not
    on the form already (`credit_note_return_twice`). It checks the invoice, because one return can hold goods of
    two invoices, and a credit note is for one (15d.1).
  - **`firstCreditableInvoice()`** picks the invoice that "Write credit note" on a return starts with. When the
    return holds goods of two invoices, the button stays on the return until both are credited, and the second
    click starts with the second invoice.
  - **`creditLeft()`** is the money cap of 15d.1: an invoice line's total less what posted credit notes took. The
    form shows it under every line, so the person sees the limit before the server says `credit_note_over_line`.
  - **`returnLineToCredit()`** prices returned goods at what the invoice charged for them. The price moves to the
    line's unit (`priceIn()`), and an amount discount is shared by the base quantity that came back, like an order's
    discount on a challan line in 15c. `formDiscount()` (15b) keeps the box at 2 decimals. With some of the return
    line credited already, it offers the rest in the base unit, like `challanLineToReturn()`.
  - **`toCreditFormLine()`** is `toFormLine()` of 15b without the item and the VAT rate: a credit note line has
    neither (they are the invoice line's, 15d.1).
- **Refunds:**
  - **`refundSourcesOf()`** turns the customer's receipts and credit notes into the places money can be paid back
    from: posted, with money left (`unappliedOf()`, 15d.1). A voided receipt and a draft credit note hold no money,
    and offering them would only end in `refund_source_invalid`. The oldest first: an advance that waited longest
    is usually the one paid back.
  - **Each source keeps its `branchId`.** A refund starts in the branch the money came in at, the same way a receipt
    starts in its invoice's branch.
  - **`sourceKeyOf()` and `sourceFields()`.** The form shows one select for two boxes (`receiptId`, `creditNoteId`),
    because the person picks one place to pay from. The select's value is `receipt:<id>` or `credit_note:<id>`, and
    `sourceFields()` turns it back into the two boxes the API wants, one of them empty (`refund_source`).

```ts
import type {
  CreditNoteSummary,
  DeliveryLine,
  InvoiceLine,
  ReceiptSummary,
  SalesReturnLine,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  challanLineToReturn,
  creditableReturnLines,
  creditLeft,
  creditReasonKey,
  firstCreditableInvoice,
  returnableLines,
  returnLineToCredit,
  returnReasonKey,
  refundSourcesOf,
  sourceFields,
  sourceKeyOf,
  toReturnFormLine,
} from './returns';

// Napa tablets, sold by the box of 10 strips; the strip is the base unit
const item = {
  variantId: 'napa',
  productId: 'p-napa',
  productCode: 'P-00031',
  productName: 'Napa 500 mg',
  optionValues: [],
  sku: 'P-00031',
  baseUnitId: 'strip',
  tracking: 'batch',
  hasExpiry: true,
  units: [{ unitId: 'box', factor: '10.000000' }],
};

// A challan line that took 3 boxes (30 strips) of batch NP24117
function challanLine(extra: Partial<DeliveryLine> = {}): DeliveryLine {
  return {
    ...item,
    id: 'dl-1',
    unitId: 'box',
    quantity: '3.0000',
    baseQuantity: '30.0000',
    batchId: 'batch-1',
    lotNumber: 'NP24117',
    expiresOn: '2027-01-31',
    manufacturedOn: null,
    serialNumbers: [],
    orderLineId: null,
    value: '270.0000',
    invoiced: true,
    returnedQuantity: '0.0000',
    ...extra,
  };
}

// The invoice line that billed it: 3 boxes at ৳120, ৳30 off in all, no VAT
function invoiceLine(extra: Partial<InvoiceLine> = {}): InvoiceLine {
  return {
    ...item,
    id: 'il-1',
    productType: 'goods',
    unitId: 'box',
    quantity: '3.0000',
    baseQuantity: '30.0000',
    description: 'Napa 500 mg',
    unitPrice: '120.0000',
    discountType: 'amount',
    discount: '30.0000',
    taxRate: { id: 'exempt', name: 'Exempt', kind: 'exempt', rate: '0.00' },
    net: '330.0000',
    vat: '0.0000',
    total: '330.0000',
    deliveryLineId: 'dl-1',
    orderLineId: null,
    deliveryNumber: 'DC-2026-27-0042',
    orderNumber: null,
    batchId: 'batch-1',
    lotNumber: 'NP24117',
    expiresOn: '2027-01-31',
    serialNumbers: [],
    credited: '0.0000',
    ...extra,
  };
}

// A posted return line: 1 box of that challan line came back, billed on INV-0001
function returnLine(extra: Partial<SalesReturnLine> = {}): SalesReturnLine {
  return {
    ...item,
    id: 'rl-1',
    unitId: 'box',
    quantity: '1.0000',
    baseQuantity: '10.0000',
    batchId: 'batch-1',
    lotNumber: 'NP24117',
    expiresOn: '2027-01-31',
    manufacturedOn: null,
    serialNumbers: [],
    deliveryLineId: 'dl-1',
    deliveryNumber: 'DC-2026-27-0042',
    billed: true,
    invoiceLineId: 'il-1',
    invoiceId: 'inv-1',
    invoiceNumber: 'INV-2026-27-0001',
    creditedQuantity: '0.0000',
    value: '90.0000',
    ...extra,
  };
}

describe('the reasons', () => {
  it('reads a reason this app does not know as Other', () => {
    expect(returnReasonKey('expired')).toBe('salesReturns.reasons.expired');
    expect(returnReasonKey('recalled')).toBe('salesReturns.reasons.other');
    expect(creditReasonKey('billing_error')).toBe('creditNotes.reasons.billing_error');
    expect(creditReasonKey('rebate')).toBe('creditNotes.reasons.other');
  });
});

describe('returnableLines and challanLineToReturn', () => {
  it('leaves out what all came back and what is on the form', () => {
    const lines = [
      challanLine({ id: 'all-back', returnedQuantity: '30.0000' }),
      challanLine({ id: 'on-form' }),
      challanLine({ id: 'open' }),
    ];
    expect(returnableLines(lines, new Set(['on-form'])).map((line) => line.id)).toEqual(['open']);
  });

  it('takes the whole line back in its own unit, with no batch', () => {
    expect(challanLineToReturn(challanLine())).toEqual({
      variantId: 'napa',
      unitId: 'box',
      quantity: '3',
      batchId: '',
      serialNumbers: [],
      deliveryLineId: 'dl-1',
    });
  });

  it('takes what is left in the base unit once some came back', () => {
    expect(challanLineToReturn(challanLine({ returnedQuantity: '12.0000' }))).toMatchObject({
      unitId: 'strip',
      quantity: '18',
    });
  });

  it('does not guess which serial numbers are still out', () => {
    const phones = challanLine({
      tracking: 'serial',
      unitId: 'strip',
      quantity: '2.0000',
      baseQuantity: '2.0000',
      serialNumbers: ['IMEI-1', 'IMEI-2'],
    });
    expect(challanLineToReturn(phones).serialNumbers).toEqual(['IMEI-1', 'IMEI-2']);
    expect(challanLineToReturn({ ...phones, returnedQuantity: '1.0000' }).serialNumbers).toEqual(
      [],
    );
  });

  it("sends a saved challan line back without the challan's batch", () => {
    expect(toReturnFormLine(returnLine())).toMatchObject({ batchId: '', deliveryLineId: 'dl-1' });
    expect(
      toReturnFormLine(returnLine({ deliveryLineId: null, deliveryNumber: null })),
    ).toMatchObject({ batchId: 'batch-1', deliveryLineId: '' });
  });
});

describe('the return lines a credit note can take', () => {
  const salesReturn = {
    lines: [
      returnLine({ id: 'credited', creditedQuantity: '10.0000' }),
      returnLine({ id: 'unbilled', invoiceLineId: null, invoiceId: null, billed: false }),
      returnLine({ id: 'other-invoice', invoiceId: 'inv-2', invoiceLineId: 'il-9' }),
      returnLine({ id: 'open' }),
    ],
  };

  it('lists billed lines of this invoice that are not all credited', () => {
    expect(creditableReturnLines(salesReturn, 'inv-1', new Set()).map((line) => line.id)).toEqual([
      'open',
    ]);
    expect(creditableReturnLines(salesReturn, 'inv-1', new Set(['open']))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('starts with the first invoice that still has goods to credit', () => {
    expect(firstCreditableInvoice(salesReturn)).toBe('inv-2');
    expect(firstCreditableInvoice({ lines: [returnLine({ creditedQuantity: '10.0000' })] })).toBe(
      null,
    );
  });

  it('credits the goods at the invoice price, with their share of an amount discount', () => {
    expect(returnLineToCredit(returnLine(), invoiceLine())).toEqual({
      invoiceLineId: 'il-1',
      returnLineId: 'rl-1',
      unitId: 'box',
      quantity: '1',
      description: '',
      unitPrice: '120.0000',
      discountType: 'amount',
      // 10 of the 30 strips carry a third of the ৳30
      discount: '10',
    });
  });

  it('credits what is left in the base unit, at the price of one strip', () => {
    const line = returnLineToCredit(
      returnLine({ quantity: '2.0000', baseQuantity: '20.0000', creditedQuantity: '5.0000' }),
      invoiceLine(),
    );
    expect(line).toMatchObject({ unitId: 'strip', quantity: '15', unitPrice: '12.0000' });
  });

  it('knows what an invoice line can still give back', () => {
    expect(creditLeft(invoiceLine({ credited: '110.0000' }))).toBe('220.0000');
  });
});

describe('refundSourcesOf', () => {
  const receipt = (extra: Partial<ReceiptSummary>): ReceiptSummary => ({
    id: 'r-1',
    number: 'MR-2026-27-0003',
    date: '2026-09-10',
    customer: { id: 'c-1', code: 'C-00007', name: 'Tamanna Pharmacy' },
    amount: '5000.0000',
    applied: '3000.0000',
    refunded: '500.0000',
    method: 'cash',
    reference: null,
    accountId: 'cash',
    branchId: 'b-1',
    status: 'posted',
    version: 1,
    updatedAt: '2026-09-10T04:00:00.000Z',
    ...extra,
  });
  const creditNote = (extra: Partial<CreditNoteSummary>): CreditNoteSummary => ({
    id: 'cn-1',
    number: 'CN-2026-27-0001',
    date: '2026-09-01',
    customer: { id: 'c-1', code: 'C-00007', name: 'Tamanna Pharmacy' },
    invoice: { id: 'inv-1', number: 'INV-2026-27-0001', date: '2026-08-20' },
    branchId: 'b-2',
    reason: 'goods_returned',
    status: 'posted',
    net: '230.0000',
    vat: '0.0000',
    total: '230.0000',
    applied: '0.0000',
    refunded: '0.0000',
    lineCount: 1,
    postedAt: '2026-09-01T04:00:00.000Z',
    version: 1,
    updatedAt: '2026-09-01T04:00:00.000Z',
    ...extra,
  });

  it('lists the money left on posted documents, the oldest first', () => {
    const sources = refundSourcesOf(
      [
        receipt({}),
        receipt({ id: 'r-void', status: 'voided' }),
        receipt({ id: 'r-used', applied: '4500.0000' }),
      ],
      [creditNote({}), creditNote({ id: 'cn-draft', status: 'draft', number: null })],
    );
    expect(sources.map((source) => [source.type, source.id, source.left])).toEqual([
      ['credit_note', 'cn-1', '230.0000'],
      ['receipt', 'r-1', '1500.0000'],
    ]);
    expect(sources[0]?.branchId).toBe('b-2');
  });

  it("turns the select's value into the two boxes and back", () => {
    expect(sourceKeyOf({ type: 'credit_note', id: 'cn-1' })).toBe('credit_note:cn-1');
    expect(sourceFields('credit_note:cn-1')).toEqual({ receiptId: '', creditNoteId: 'cn-1' });
    expect(sourceFields('receipt:r-1')).toEqual({ receiptId: 'r-1', creditNoteId: '' });
    expect(sourceFields('')).toEqual({ receiptId: '', creditNoteId: '' });
  });
});
```

- **The story is a pharmacy's**: Napa tablets sold by the box of 10 strips, batch NP24117, an invoice line of 3 boxes
  at ৳120 with ৳30 off. The numbers are small enough to check by hand.
- **The tests say what the screens promise**: a whole line comes back in its own unit, the rest of a partly
  returned line comes back in strips, serial numbers are not guessed, a saved challan line loses its batch, a credit
  for 1 box of 3 carries ৳10 of the ৳30 discount, the rest of a partly credited line is priced at ৳12 a strip, and
  the refund sources leave out a voided receipt, a used receipt and a draft credit note.


- **Everything under `['sales', tenantId]`**, like 15b and 15c. Posting a return changes its challans and its order,
  posting a credit note changes its invoice, and a refund changes its receipt or credit note. One invalidate
  (`useSalesRefresh()`) refreshes all of them, and nobody has to remember which lists a document touches.
- **The lists** (`salesReturnsQuery`, `creditNotesQuery`, `refundsQuery`) are the infinite lists of 15c, with the
  status and customer filters their contracts offer.
- **The pickers read 100 at most**, like the invoice form's challan picker:
  - `returnableChallansQuery` asks the API for `?return=returnable` (15d.1), the challans with goods that can still
    come back.
  - `postedInvoicesQuery` is the credit note form's invoice select. The invoice list has no text search (15c.1), so
    the select shows the customer's newest 100. An older invoice is credited from its own page.
  - `postedReturnsQuery` is the credit note form's return picker. The list cannot say which returns hold goods of
    the chosen invoice, so the picker opens a return to see.
- **`refundSourcesQuery` returns the two lists as they came.** Neither list has a filter for "money left" (15d.5), so
  the form keeps the ones with money left with `refundSourcesOf()`. That happens in the form (`select`), not here:
  every list page imports this file, and `lib/returns.ts` would ride along into each of their chunks. That was 0.3
  KB on every list, and the lists are at their budget (see the last section).
- **`salesAccountsQuery`** has its own key, `['sales-accounts', tenantId]`, like the stock accounts of step 14: the
  settings card invalidates only it.

- **The status pills move out** to `sales-pills.tsx`. A form imports this file for the back link and the refresh
  hook, and with the pills here, every form's chunk carried a dozen status icons it never shows. With the three new
  documents' pills, the receipt form went over its budget; without the pills it is at 97 KB.
- **`LinkList`, `LINK_ROW` and `LINK_NUMBER`** moved here from `invoice-view.tsx`. The challan, return and credit
  note pages show lists of linked documents too. `empty` replaces the list with a sentence ("Nothing paid yet."),
  which the invoice's payments card did by hand in 15c.
- **`PickButton` and `PickProblem`** moved here from `invoice-lines.tsx`. The return form's challan picker and the
  credit note's two pickers use them, and importing them from `invoice-lines.tsx` would pull the whole invoice
  editor into those chunks.
- **`SalesBackLink`** takes the three new lists.

```tsx
import {
  Agreement01Icon,
  CancelCircleIcon,
  CheckmarkCircle02Icon,
  Clock01Icon,
  Coins01Icon,
  DeliveryReturn01Icon,
  DeliveryTruck01Icon,
  FileEditIcon,
  HourglassIcon,
  Invoice01Icon,
  Invoice02Icon,
  Invoice03Icon,
  Invoice04Icon,
  PackageDeliveredIcon,
  PackageReceiveIcon,
  StopCircleIcon,
  Time04Icon,
} from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import {
  creditStateOf,
  type DeliveryInvoiceState,
  type DeliveryReturnState,
  type InvoiceStatus,
  isOverdue,
  type OrderStatus,
  paymentStatusOf,
  type QuotationStatus,
  type ReceiptStatus,
  type StockDocumentStatus,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { Pill } from '@omnivo/ui';

import { isExpired, isLate } from '../lib/sales';

// The status pills of the sales documents. Split from sales-parts.tsx in step 15d: a form needs
// the back link and the refresh hook from there, not a dozen status icons, and with the pills
// inside, every form's chunk carried them all (receipt-form.tsx went over its 100 KB budget).
// Never colour alone: each pill has its icon and its words.

// Open, Expired (open, but the offer has ended: attention), Accepted, Declined. Never colour alone.
export function QuotationStatusPill({
  quotation,
  today,
}: {
  quotation: { status: QuotationStatus; validUntil: string | null };
  today: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  if (isExpired(quotation, today)) {
    return (
      <Pill tone="warn" icon={HourglassIcon}>
        {t('quotations.expired')}
      </Pill>
    );
  }
  if (quotation.status === 'accepted') {
    return (
      <Pill tone="good" icon={CheckmarkCircle02Icon}>
        {t('quotations.statuses.accepted')}
      </Pill>
    );
  }
  if (quotation.status === 'declined') {
    return (
      <Pill tone="neutral" icon={CancelCircleIcon}>
        {t('quotations.statuses.declined')}
      </Pill>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Pill tone="brand" icon={Clock01Icon}>
      {t('quotations.statuses.open')}
    </Pill>
  );
}

const ORDER_PILLS = {
  draft: { tone: 'neutral', icon: FileEditIcon },
  confirmed: { tone: 'brand', icon: Agreement01Icon },
  delivered: { tone: 'good', icon: PackageDeliveredIcon },
  closed: { tone: 'neutral', icon: StopCircleIcon },
  cancelled: { tone: 'neutral', icon: CancelCircleIcon },
} as const;

// The status, and beside it what a confirmed order is up to: partly delivered (brand: work in
// progress, not a problem) and late (warn: its delivery date has passed)
export function OrderStatusPills({
  order,
  today,
}: {
  order: { status: OrderStatus; partlyDelivered: boolean; deliveryDate: string | null };
  today: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const pill = ORDER_PILLS[order.status];
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      {order.partlyDelivered ? (
        <Pill tone="brand" icon={DeliveryTruck01Icon}>
          {t('salesOrders.partlyDelivered')}
        </Pill>
      ) : (
        <Pill tone={pill.tone} icon={pill.icon}>
          {t(`salesOrders.statuses.${order.status}`)}
        </Pill>
      )}
      {isLate(order, today) && (
        <Pill tone="warn" icon={Time04Icon}>
          {t('salesOrders.late')}
        </Pill>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

export function DeliveryStatusPill({ status }: { status: StockDocumentStatus }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return status === 'draft' ? (
    <Pill tone="neutral" icon={FileEditIcon}>
      {t('deliveries.statuses.draft')}
    </Pill>
  ) : (
    <Pill tone="good" icon={CheckmarkCircle02Icon}>
      {t('deliveries.statuses.posted')}
    </Pill>
  );
}

// Step 15c: how much of a posted challan is billed. A draft shows nothing: it cannot be billed yet.
const INVOICE_STATE_PILLS = {
  not_invoiced: { tone: 'neutral', icon: Invoice01Icon },
  partly_invoiced: { tone: 'brand', icon: Invoice03Icon },
  invoiced: { tone: 'good', icon: Invoice02Icon },
} as const;

// Step 15d: how much of a posted challan came back. Nothing came back shows no pill: that is the
// normal case, and a pill on every row would say nothing. Neutral, not a status colour: a return is
// neither a success nor a problem.
const RETURN_STATE_PILLS = {
  partly_returned: { icon: DeliveryReturn01Icon },
  returned: { icon: PackageReceiveIcon },
} as const;

export function ReturnStatePill({ state }: { state: DeliveryReturnState }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  if (state === 'none') return null;
  return (
    <Pill tone="neutral" icon={RETURN_STATE_PILLS[state].icon}>
      {t(`deliveries.returnStates.${state}`)}
    </Pill>
  );
}

export function InvoiceStatePill({ state }: { state: DeliveryInvoiceState }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const pill = INVOICE_STATE_PILLS[state];
  return (
    <Pill tone={pill.tone} icon={pill.icon}>
      {t(`deliveries.invoiceStates.${state}`)}
    </Pill>
  );
}

const PAYMENT_PILLS = {
  unpaid: { tone: 'brand', icon: Clock01Icon },
  partly_paid: { tone: 'brand', icon: Coins01Icon },
  paid: { tone: 'good', icon: CheckmarkCircle02Icon },
} as const;

// A draft says Draft. A posted invoice says what was paid (unpaid and partly paid are brand: money
// on its way, not a problem), and beside it Overdue (crit, CLAUDE.md: overdue) once its due date
// has passed. Worked out here from the totals and today: nothing is stored when the date passes.
// Step 15d: an invoice credit notes took back in full says Credited (neutral: the sale is undone,
// like a cancelled order) instead of what was paid; one taken back in part says so beside it. What
// credit notes applied counts as settled (paymentStatusOf, isOverdue).
export function InvoicePills({
  invoice,
  today,
}: {
  invoice: {
    status: InvoiceStatus;
    dueDate: string;
    total: string;
    amountPaid: string;
    amountCredited: string;
    creditNoteTotal: string;
  };
  today: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  if (invoice.status === 'draft') {
    return (
      <Pill tone="neutral" icon={FileEditIcon}>
        {t('invoices.statuses.draft')}
      </Pill>
    );
  }
  const credit = creditStateOf(invoice);
  if (credit === 'credited') {
    return (
      <Pill tone="neutral" icon={Invoice04Icon}>
        {t('invoices.creditStates.credited')}
      </Pill>
    );
  }
  const payment = paymentStatusOf(invoice);
  const pill = PAYMENT_PILLS[payment];
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      <Pill tone={pill.tone} icon={pill.icon}>
        {t(`invoices.payment.${payment}`)}
      </Pill>
      {credit === 'partly_credited' && (
        <Pill tone="neutral" icon={Invoice04Icon}>
          {t('invoices.creditStates.partly_credited')}
        </Pill>
      )}
      {isOverdue(invoice, today) && (
        <Pill tone="crit" icon={Time04Icon}>
          {t('invoices.overdue')}
        </Pill>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

export function ReceiptStatusPill({ status }: { status: ReceiptStatus }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return status === 'voided' ? (
    <Pill tone="neutral" icon={CancelCircleIcon}>
      {t('receipts.statuses.voided')}
    </Pill>
  ) : (
    <Pill tone="good" icon={CheckmarkCircle02Icon}>
      {t('receipts.statuses.posted')}
    </Pill>
  );
}

// Step 15d: the statuses of a sales return and a credit note (draft, posted) and of a refund
// (posted, voided). Like a challan's and a receipt's: posted is good, and a draft or a voided one is
// neutral. The words are each document's own (salesReturns.statuses.posted), so the page passes them.
const DOCUMENT_PILLS = {
  draft: { tone: 'neutral', icon: FileEditIcon },
  posted: { tone: 'good', icon: CheckmarkCircle02Icon },
  voided: { tone: 'neutral', icon: CancelCircleIcon },
} as const;

export function DocumentStatusPill({
  status,
  label,
}: {
  status: keyof typeof DOCUMENT_PILLS;
  label: string;
}) {
  const pill = DOCUMENT_PILLS[status];
  return (
    <Pill tone={pill.tone} icon={pill.icon}>
      {label}
    </Pill>
  );
}
```

- **The 15b and 15c pills, unchanged**, but for `InvoicePills`.
- **`InvoicePills` reads the credits** (decision 5):
  - An invoice whose credit notes took back the whole total says **Credited**, neutral with an `Invoice04` icon,
    instead of what was paid. The sale is undone, like a cancelled order, so it is neither good nor a problem, and
    "Paid" would be false: nobody paid it.
  - One taken back in part shows **Partly credited** beside the payment pill.
  - The payment pill and Overdue read `amountCredited` (`paymentStatusOf()`, `isOverdue()` of 15d.1): what a credit
    note applied counts as settled. Without it, an invoice settled by a credit note would stay "Unpaid" and turn
    "Overdue".
- **`ReturnStatePill`**: how much of a posted challan came back. **No pill when nothing came back**: that is the
  normal case, and a pill on every row would say nothing. Neutral, because a return is neither a success nor a
  problem. The two states have their own icons, so the pill never relies on its words alone.
- **`DocumentStatusPill`** serves the three new documents: Draft (neutral, `FileEdit`), Posted (good,
  `CheckmarkCircle02`), Voided (neutral, `CancelCircle`), the same look as a challan's and a receipt's. The words
  are each document's own (`salesReturns.statuses.posted`), so the page passes the label.

```tsx
import { allocationRows } from '../lib/invoices';
import { rowPath } from '../lib/products';
import { openInvoicesQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { AllocationTable } from './allocation-table';
import { useSalesRefresh } from './sales-parts';
import { useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// The dialogs of the money documents, a lazy chunk of their own (receipt-view.tsx says why):
// "Apply money" on a receipt and (step 15d) on a credit note, and "Void" on a receipt and on a
// refund. Called receipt-dialogs.tsx in 15c; each document passes what differs (its route, its
// error codes, its words), so one dialog serves both.

// The void date's picker as a chunk of its own: with the popover inside, the dialogs stood at
// 106 KB of their 100 KB budget
const DatePicker = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./date-input')).DatePicker }));

// "Apply money": the document's money over the customer's invoices again, the whole list at once
// (an advance that came before its invoice, money put on the wrong invoice, or the rest of a credit
// note kept as an advance)
export function ApplyForm({
  title,
  customerId,
  amount,
  version,
  allocations,
  resolver,
  save,
  onDone,
}: {
  title: string;
  customerId: string;
  // What the money can cover: the receipt's amount or the credit note's total, less what refunds
  // paid back (the server's cap; the table's "Left as advance" counts from it)
  amount: string;
  version: number;
  allocations: readonly ReceiptAllocation[];
  // The document's own schema: the shape is the same, the error codes are its own
  resolver: Resolver<ReceiptAllocationsFormValues, unknown, ReceiptAllocationsInput>;
  // Sends the new list; answers the toast's words
  save: (body: ReceiptAllocationsInput) => Promise<string>;
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const refresh = useSalesRefresh();
  const { data: open } = useQuery(openInvoicesQuery(tenantId, customerId));
  // Its own invoices too: one it paid in full is not open any more
  const rows = useMemo(() => allocationRows(open ?? [], allocations), [open, allocations]);
  const {
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    getValues,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm<ReceiptAllocationsFormValues, unknown, ReceiptAllocationsInput>({
    resolver,
    defaultValues: {
      version,
      allocations: allocations.map((allocation) => ({
        invoiceId: allocation.invoiceId,
        amount: plainQuantity(allocation.amount),
      })),
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    try {
      const done = await save(values);
      await refresh();
      toast(done);
      onDone();
    } catch (error) {
      const count = getValues('allocations').length;
      const names: Path<ReceiptAllocationsFormValues>[] = [
        'allocations',
        ...Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => [
          rowPath('allocations', index, 'invoiceId'),
          rowPath('allocations', index, 'amount'),
        ]).flat(),
      ];
      applyApiError(error, names, setError);
    }
  });

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={title}
      description={t('receipts.applySubtitle')}
      footer={
        <>
          <DialogClose asChild>
            <Button variant="secondary">{t('common.cancel')}</Button>
          </DialogClose>
          <Button type="submit" form="apply-form" disabled={isSubmitting}>
            {isSubmitting ? t('common.saving') : t('receipts.applySave')}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form id="apply-form" noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void onSubmit(event)}>
        {errors.root?.server?.message && <FormAlert message={errors.root.server.message} />}
        {/* The table's own padding is a card's; the dialog has its own, so it runs edge to edge */}
        <div className="-mx-[18px] sm:-mx-6">
          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="allocations"
            render={({ field }) => (
              <AllocationTable
                rows={rows}
                value={field.value}
                onChange={field.onChange}
                amount={amount}
                errors={errors.allocations}
                empty={t('receipts.noOpenInvoices')}
              />
            )}
          />
        </div>
      </form>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}

// "Void": the date the money turned out not to be there (or never reached the customer), and why.
// `words` picks the document's own texts; both have the same keys, but for the dialog's No button.
export function VoidForm({
  words,
  number,
  version,
  today,
  save,
  onDone,
}: {
  words: 'receipts' | 'refunds';
  number: string;
  version: number;
  today: string;
  save: (body: VoidReceiptInput) => Promise<void>;
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const refresh = useSalesRefresh();
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(voidReceiptInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: { version, date: today, reason: '' },
  });

  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    try {
      await save(values);
      await refresh();
      toast(t(`${words}.voided`, { number }));
      onDone();
    } catch (error) {
      applyApiError(error, ['date', 'reason'], setError);
    }
  });

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t(`${words}.voidTitle`, { number })}
      description={t(`${words}.voidBody`)}
      footer={
        <>
          <DialogClose asChild>
            <Button variant="secondary">
              {words === 'receipts' ? t('receipts.keepReceipt') : t('refunds.keepRefund')}
            </Button>
          </DialogClose>
          <Button type="submit" form="void-form" disabled={isSubmitting}>
            {t(`${words}.confirmVoid`)}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form
        id="void-form"
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(event) => void onSubmit(event)}
        className="grid gap-5"
      >
        {errors.root?.server?.message && <FormAlert message={errors.root.server.message} />}
        <FormField
          control={control}
          name="date"
          label={t(`${words}.voidDate`)}
          hint={t(`${words}.voidDateHint`)}
        >
          {(field) => (
            <Suspense fallback={<Input id={field.id} icon={Calendar03Icon} disabled />}>
              <DatePicker {...field} />
            </Suspense>
          )}
        </FormField>
        <TextField
          label={t(`${words}.voidReason`)}
          placeholder={t(`${words}.voidReasonPlaceholder`)}
          {...register('reason')}
          error={errors.reason?.message}
        />
      </form>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
```

- **One dialog for two documents.** "Apply money" is the same on a receipt and on a credit note, and "Void" the
  same on a receipt and on a refund. Copying them would give two copies to keep in step, so each dialog now takes
  what differs, and the new name says what the file holds.
- **`ApplyForm` takes:**
  - **`amount`**, what the money can cover: the receipt's amount or the credit note's total, less what refunds paid
    back. Money paid back cannot also go on an invoice (`receipt_over_allocated`, `credit_note_over_allocated`), so
    the table's "Left as advance" counts from what is really left.
  - **`resolver`**, the document's own schema. The two schemas have the same shape but their own error codes
    (`credit_note_invoice_twice`, not `receipt_invoice_twice`), so the page passes it. The type is the receipt's;
    the credit note's schema infers the same types, so it fits without a cast.
  - **`save`**, which sends the list and answers the toast's words. The route and the toast are the document's.
- **`VoidForm` takes `words`**, `'receipts'` or `'refunds'`. Both have the same keys (`voidTitle`, `voidDateHint`,
  …), so `` t(`${words}.voidTitle`) `` is typed for both, and the dialog reads in the document's own words. Only the
  No button's key differs (`keepReceipt`, `keepRefund`). The schema is the receipt's: the refund's is the same one
  (`voidRefundInputSchema`, 15d.1).

- **"Paid back"** shows under the amount once a refund paid some of it back.
- **The advance is `unappliedOf()`**: amount less applied less refunded (15d.1). The notice and the "Pay back"
  button read it, so a receipt paid back in full stops offering either.
- **"Pay back" needs `sales.refund.manage`**, not `sales.receipt.manage`: paying money out is its own permission
  (15d.1). The row of buttons shows when the person has either.
- **The dialogs come from `money-dialogs.tsx`.** The receipt's resolver is made once, at the top of the file: it
  never changes, so there is no reason to build it again on every render.

- **Two new modes for a sales return:**
  - **`return`**, a line on its own: the batch select lists the item's batches in every warehouse, each lot once.
    The goods come back with the lot printed on them, and the warehouse they come back into (a damage store) often
    holds none of that lot. The `out` mode lists only what is in the form's warehouse, which would hide the very lot
    on the box. The label is the lot and its expiry, without a quantity: what is in stock says nothing about what
    came back. The list comes from the stock card, which shows lots with stock. A lot with none left anywhere is not
    on it; the API would take it (any batch of the item, 15d.3), but such goods nearly always left on a challan in
    the system, and come back from there.
  - **`fixed`**, a line from a challan: no batch box at all. The server takes the challan line's batch.
- **The stock card is read in `return` mode even before a warehouse is picked**: its batches are what the select
  shows.
- **`errors.line`** shows a problem with the line itself under the item, with an icon: an item with no cost yet
  (`return_cost_unknown`, 15d.3) or a challan line that is not the customer's. The person fixes those by removing
  the line, and no box of the row is the place for them.
- **`onSplit` is optional.** FEFO splits a line that takes stock out by expiry; a return has nothing to split, and a
  required prop would force the return form to pass a function that does nothing.

- **It takes a return's lines too** (`SalesReturnLine` in `DocumentLine`): a return line has the same stock fields
  and a value.
- **`detail`** adds the page's own words under a line: on a challan, how much came back; on a return, the challan it
  left on and whether it was billed. The table is generic over the line (`L extends DocumentLine`), so each page's
  function gets its own line type without a cast.
- **The dash ("—") shows only when nothing else is in the cell**, so a line with a detail does not also say "—".

  billed yet" is worth saying; "nothing came back" is not.

  still come back and the person has `sales.return.manage`. It is a secondary button: billing stays the accountant's
  main next step, and a view has one primary button.


- **"Credited"** shows under "Paid" once a credit note applied money to the invoice, and "Due" is `amountDueOf()`.
  Without the row, "Paid" and "Due" would not add up to the total.
- **The credit notes card** lists the posted credit notes with their whole totals, as "−৳230.00": a credit note's
  money may have gone partly to another invoice, but the card says what each took back from this one's sale. Where
  the money went is on the credit note's page.
- **"Credit whole invoice"** (decision 5) posts a draft built by `wholeInvoiceCreditLines()` (15d.1) and opens it, with
  the toast "Draft credit note written for every line. Check it, then post it." It is a draft so nobody takes back a
  whole sale with one click, and a draft is what the person can check and change. The reason is "Other": the
  person picks the real one on the draft. It shows only while `canCreditWhole()` is true (no posted credit note);
  after one, the full amounts would pass the money cap (15d.1).
- **"Write credit note"** opens an empty credit note for this invoice. It hides once the invoice is fully credited:
  nothing is left to take back.
- **"Record payment" stays the primary button** while something is due; the two credit buttons are secondary. Paying
  is the common next step, and crediting the exception.
- **A failed "Credit whole invoice" shows above the buttons**, with the server's words (a closed period, for one).

### Sales returns: `return-form.tsx`, `return-view.tsx` and their routes (new)

```tsx
import {
  Calendar03Icon,
  Delete02Icon,
  DeliveryReturn01Icon,
  PlusSignIcon,
  UserIcon,
} from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  contractErrorMap,
  type Delivery,
  type DeliveryLine,
  MAX_STOCK_LINES,
  RETURN_REASONS,
  routes,
  type SalesReturn,
  type SalesReturnFormValues,
  type StockItem,
  updateSalesReturnInputSchema,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  EmptyState,
  FormAlert,
  FormField,
  Input,
  PageHeader,
  SelectField,
  TextField,
  toast,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useMutation, useQueries, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense, useState } from 'react';
import { Controller, type Path, useFieldArray, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { applyApiError } from '../lib/field-errors';
import { rowPath } from '../lib/products';
import { deliveryQuery, returnableChallansQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import {
  challanLineToReturn,
  leftToReturn,
  returnableLines,
  returnReasonKey,
  toReturnFormLine,
} from '../lib/returns';
import { firstMessage, serialPath } from '../lib/stock';
import { ItemPicker } from './item-picker';
import { failureOf, LineField } from './journal-parts';
import { PickButton, PickProblem, SalesBackLink, useSalesRefresh } from './sales-parts';
import { SerialNumbersInput } from './serial-numbers-input';
import { type LineItem, StockLineRow, StockLinesHeader, toLineItem } from './stock-line-row';
import { useIsoDate, useQuantity, useTenantId, useWarehouses, warehouseLabel } from './stock-parts';

// The sales return form (step 15d): its own chunk, loaded by routes/sales-return.tsx. A return is a
// stock document with a customer, like the delivery form: its lines are the stock line rows of
// step 13, and a line taken back from a challan also names that challan line.

// Both bring the popover; the delivery form says why that matters for the chunk
const CustomerPicker = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./customer-picker')).CustomerPicker,
}));
const DatePicker = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./date-input')).DatePicker }));

type FormValues = SalesReturnFormValues;
type LineValues = FormValues['lines'][number];

// A line on its own (goods sold before the system was used): no challan line, a batch to pick
function ownLine(item: LineItem): LineValues {
  return {
    variantId: item.variantId,
    unitId: item.baseUnitId,
    quantity: '',
    batchId: '',
    serialNumbers: [],
    deliveryLineId: '',
  };
}

function fieldNames(lines: readonly LineValues[]): Path<FormValues>[] {
  return [
    'customerId',
    'date',
    'warehouseId',
    'reason',
    'note',
    'lines',
    ...lines.flatMap((line, index) => [
      rowPath('lines', index, 'variantId'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'unitId'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'quantity'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'batchId'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'serialNumbers'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'deliveryLineId'),
      ...line.serialNumbers.map((_, serial) => serialPath(index, serial)),
    ]),
  ];
}

// The challan line behind a return line, with its challan's number: what the row says under the
// item ("From DC-2026-27-0042 · 18 strip can still come back")
interface ChallanSource {
  number: string;
  line: DeliveryLine;
}

// Writing a new return (from a challan, or from nothing), or changing a draft. "Save draft" keeps
// it a draft; "Post return" saves and posts in one request: the goods come back into stock and their
// cost comes off the cost of goods sold, all or nothing.
export function ReturnForm({
  salesReturn,
  delivery,
  today,
}: {
  salesReturn: SalesReturn | null;
  // "Take goods back" on a challan: the form starts with what can still come back on it
  delivery: Delivery | null;
  today: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const refresh = useSalesRefresh();
  const quantityText = useQuantity();
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState<'challans' | 'items' | null>(null);
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ReadonlyMap<string, LineItem>>(
    () =>
      new Map(
        [...(salesReturn?.lines ?? []), ...(delivery?.lines ?? [])].map((line) => [
          line.variantId,
          toLineItem(line),
        ]),
      ),
  );
  // The challans the lines come from: a draft's, the one it started from, and the ones the picker
  // adds. Read through the query cache, so the rows can say what is left on each challan line.
  const [deliveryIds, setDeliveryIds] = useState<readonly string[]>(() => [
    ...new Set([
      ...(salesReturn?.deliveries.map((ref) => ref.id) ?? []),
      ...(delivery ? [delivery.id] : []),
    ]),
  ]);
  const challans = useQueries({
    queries: deliveryIds.map((id) => deliveryQuery(tenantId, id)),
  });
  const sources = new Map<string, ChallanSource>();
  for (const challan of challans) {
    for (const line of challan.data?.lines ?? []) {
      sources.set(line.id, { number: challan.data?.number ?? '', line });
    }
  }

  const savedCustomer = salesReturn?.customer ?? delivery?.customer ?? null;
  const { active } = useWarehouses();
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    setValue,
    getValues,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(updateSalesReturnInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: {
      customerId: savedCustomer?.id ?? '',
      date: salesReturn?.date ?? today,
      // From a challan: back where the goods left from, unless the store keeper picks a damage
      // store. Otherwise the only warehouse, or none.
      warehouseId:
        salesReturn?.warehouseId ??
        delivery?.warehouseId ??
        (active?.length === 1 ? (active[0]?.id ?? '') : ''),
      // A native select always shows one: the first reason, until the store keeper picks another
      reason: RETURN_REASONS.find((reason) => reason === salesReturn?.reason) ?? RETURN_REASONS[0],
      note: salesReturn?.note ?? '',
      lines:
        salesReturn?.lines.map(toReturnFormLine) ??
        (delivery ? returnableLines(delivery.lines, new Set()).map(challanLineToReturn) : []),
      post: false,
      version: salesReturn?.version ?? 1,
    },
  });
  const { fields, append, remove, replace } = useFieldArray({ control, name: 'lines' });
  const lines = useWatch({ control, name: 'lines' });
  const customerId = useWatch({ control, name: 'customerId' });
  const warehouseId = useWatch({ control, name: 'warehouseId' });

  const addItems = (next: readonly LineItem[]) => {
    setItems((before) => {
      const map = new Map(before);
      for (const item of next) map.set(item.variantId, toLineItem(item));
      return map;
    });
  };

  // Another customer: the lines from the old customer's challans go (the API refuses them,
  // return_delivery_line_invalid); lines on their own stay
  const changeCustomer = (next: string) => {
    setValue('customerId', next, { shouldValidate: errors.customerId !== undefined });
    const kept = getValues('lines').filter((line) => (line.deliveryLineId ?? '') === '');
    if (kept.length !== getValues('lines').length) replace(kept);
  };

  // The picker's challan: what can still come back on it, less what is on the form already.
  // false = the return would hold too many lines; nothing is added.
  const addChallan = (challan: Delivery): boolean => {
    const onForm = new Set(
      getValues('lines').flatMap((line) => {
        const id = line.deliveryLineId ?? '';
        return id === '' ? [] : [id];
      }),
    );
    const left = returnableLines(challan.lines, onForm);
    if (getValues('lines').length + left.length > MAX_STOCK_LINES) return false;
    addItems(left);
    setDeliveryIds((before) => (before.includes(challan.id) ? before : [...before, challan.id]));
    append(left.map(challanLineToReturn));
    return true;
  };

  const save = (post: boolean) =>
    handleSubmit(async ({ version, ...values }) => {
      try {
        const body = { ...values, post };
        const saved = salesReturn
          ? await call(routes.salesReturns.update, {
              params: { id: salesReturn.id },
              body: { ...body, version },
            })
          : await call(routes.salesReturns.create, { body });
        await refresh();
        toast(
          saved.status === 'posted'
            ? t('salesReturns.posted', { number: saved.number ?? '' })
            : t('salesReturns.draftSaved'),
        );
        if (!salesReturn) {
          void navigate({
            to: '/sales-returns/$returnId',
            params: { returnId: saved.id },
            replace: true,
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        applyApiError(error, fieldNames(lines), setError);
      }
    });

  const removeDraft = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (draft: SalesReturn) =>
      call(routes.salesReturns.remove, {
        params: { id: draft.id },
        query: { version: draft.version },
      }),
    onSuccess: async () => {
      await refresh();
      toast(t('salesReturns.deleted'));
      void navigate({ to: '/sales-returns' });
    },
  });

  const failure = errors.root?.server?.message ?? failureOf(removeDraft.error);
  const linesError = errors.lines?.root?.message ?? errors.lines?.message;

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <SalesBackLink to="/sales-returns" label={t('salesReturns.back')} />
      <PageHeader
        title={salesReturn ? t('salesReturns.draftTitle') : t('salesReturns.newTitle')}
        description={t('salesReturns.description')}
      />
      <form
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(event) => void save(false)(event)}
        className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5"
      >
        {failure && <FormAlert message={failure} />}
        <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-x-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <FormField control={control} name="customerId" label={t('salesReturns.customer')}>
            {(field) => (
              <Suspense fallback={<Input id={field.id} icon={UserIcon} disabled />}>
                <CustomerPicker {...field} saved={savedCustomer} onChange={changeCustomer} />
              </Suspense>
            )}
          </FormField>
          <FormField control={control} name="date" label={t('salesReturns.date')}>
            {(field) => (
              <Suspense fallback={<Input id={field.id} icon={Calendar03Icon} disabled />}>
                <DatePicker {...field} />
              </Suspense>
            )}
          </FormField>
          <SelectField
            label={t('salesReturns.reason')}
            options={RETURN_REASONS.map((reason) => ({
              value: reason,
              label: t(returnReasonKey(reason)),
            }))}
            {...register('reason')}
            error={errors.reason?.message}
          />
          <div className="sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3">
            <SelectField
              label={t('salesReturns.warehouse')}
              hint={t('salesReturns.warehouseHint')}
              options={[
                { value: '', label: t('stockLines.pickWarehouse') },
                ...(active ?? []).map((place) => ({
                  value: place.id,
                  label: warehouseLabel(place),
                })),
              ]}
              {...register('warehouseId')}
              error={errors.warehouseId?.message}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3">
            <TextField
              label={t('salesReturns.note')}
              optional
              placeholder={t('salesReturns.notePlaceholder')}
              {...register('note')}
              error={errors.note?.message}
            />
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card
          className="@container grid grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden"
          aria-label={t('stockLines.items')}
        >
          {fields.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="px-5 py-6 text-body-sm text-ink-2">{t('stockLines.noLines')}</p>
          ) : (
            <StockLinesHeader />
          )}
          {fields.map((field, index) => {
            const item = items.get(field.variantId);
            if (!item) return null;
            const lineErrors = errors.lines?.[index];
            const serials = rowPath('lines', index, 'serialNumbers');
            const deliveryLineId = lines[index]?.deliveryLineId ?? '';
            const source = deliveryLineId === '' ? undefined : sources.get(deliveryLineId);
            return (
              <StockLineRow
                key={field.id}
                index={index}
                item={item}
                mode={deliveryLineId === '' ? 'return' : 'fixed'}
                warehouseId={warehouseId}
                unitId={lines[index]?.unitId ?? item.baseUnitId}
                quantity={lines[index]?.quantity ?? ''}
                fields={{
                  unitId: register(rowPath('lines', index, 'unitId')),
                  quantity: register(rowPath('lines', index, 'quantity')),
                  batchId: register(rowPath('lines', index, 'batchId')),
                }}
                note={
                  deliveryLineId === '' ? (
                    <span className="text-caption text-ink-3">{t('salesReturns.ownLine')}</span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="grid gap-0.5 text-caption text-ink-3">
                      <span className="font-medium text-ink-2">
                        {t('salesReturns.fromChallan', { number: source?.number ?? '' })}
                        {source?.line.lotNumber &&
                          ` · ${t('print.batch', { lot: source.line.lotNumber })}`}
                      </span>
                      {/* What posted returns left on it; this draft's own quantity is not
                          counted yet */}
                      {source && (
                        <span className="tabular-nums">
                          {t('salesReturns.leftToReturn', {
                            quantity: quantityText(leftToReturn(source.line), item.baseUnitId),
                          })}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span>{t('salesReturns.challanLineHint')}</span>
                    </span>
                  )
                }
                serials={
                  <Controller
                    control={control}
                    name={serials}
                    render={({ field: serialField }) => {
                      const error = firstMessage(lineErrors?.serialNumbers);
                      return (
                        <LineField id={serials} label={t('stockLines.serials')} error={error}>
                          <SerialNumbersInput
                            id={serials}
                            name={serialField.name}
                            ref={serialField.ref}
                            value={serialField.value}
                            onChange={serialField.onChange}
                            onBlur={serialField.onBlur}
                            invalid={error !== undefined}
                          />
                          <span className="text-caption text-ink-3">
                            {t('stockLines.serialsHint')}
                          </span>
                        </LineField>
                      );
                    }}
                  />
                }
                errors={{
                  // The item has no cost yet (return_cost_unknown), or the challan line is not
                  // this customer's (return_delivery_line_invalid) or on the return twice
                  line: lineErrors?.variantId?.message ?? lineErrors?.deliveryLineId?.message,
                  unitId: lineErrors?.unitId?.message,
                  quantity: lineErrors?.quantity?.message,
                  batchId: lineErrors?.batchId?.message,
                }}
                onRemove={() => {
                  remove(index);
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
          {linesError && (
            <div className="border-t border-line px-5 py-3">
              <FormAlert message={linesError} />
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line px-5 py-3">
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              disabled={customerId === ''}
              onClick={() => {
                setPicking('challans');
              }}
            >
              <HugeiconsIcon icon={DeliveryReturn01Icon} size={16} strokeWidth={1.5} />
              {t('salesReturns.addChallans')}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              disabled={warehouseId === ''}
              onClick={() => {
                setPicking('items');
              }}
            >
              <HugeiconsIcon icon={PlusSignIcon} size={16} strokeWidth={1.5} />
              {t('stockLines.addItems')}
            </Button>
            {customerId === '' && (
              <span className="text-label text-ink-3">{t('salesReturns.pickCustomerFirst')}</span>
            )}
            {customerId !== '' && warehouseId === '' && (
              <span className="text-label text-ink-3">{t('stockLines.pickWarehouse')}</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
          {salesReturn && (
            <div className="mr-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                disabled={removeDraft.isPending}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (confirming) removeDraft.mutate(salesReturn);
                  else setConfirming(true);
                }}
              >
                <HugeiconsIcon icon={Delete02Icon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
                {confirming ? t('salesReturns.confirmDelete') : t('salesReturns.deleteDraft')}
              </Button>
              {confirming && (
                <span className="text-body-sm text-ink-2">{t('salesReturns.deleteWarning')}</span>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" disabled={isSubmitting}>
            {t('salesReturns.saveDraft')}
          </Button>
          <Button disabled={isSubmitting || fields.length === 0} onClick={() => void save(true)()}>
            {isSubmitting ? t('salesReturns.posting') : t('salesReturns.post')}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <p className="text-right text-label text-ink-3">{t('salesReturns.postHint')}</p>
      </form>

      <Dialog
        open={picking !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setPicking(null);
        }}
      >
        {picking === 'challans' && <ChallanPicker customerId={customerId} onAdd={addChallan} />}
        {picking === 'items' && (
          <ItemPicker
            warehouseId={warehouseId}
            // An archived product can still come back (the API's rule, 15d.3)
            allowArchived
            onAdd={(item: StockItem) => {
              addItems([item]);
              append(ownLine(item));
            }}
          />
        )}
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

// "Add from challans": the customer's posted challans with goods that can still come back. Each
// click adds what is left on that challan. The dialog stays open: a pharmacy sends back strips of
// several deliveries in one carton.
function ChallanPicker({
  customerId,
  onAdd,
}: {
  customerId: string;
  onAdd: (challan: Delivery) => boolean;
}) {
  const { t, errorText } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const { data: challans } = useQuery(returnableChallansQuery(tenantId, customerId));
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const pick = async (deliveryId: string) => {
    setLoading(deliveryId);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      const challan = await queryClient.query(deliveryQuery(tenantId, deliveryId));
      if (onAdd(challan)) setAdded((before) => new Set(before).add(deliveryId));
      else setProblem(t('salesLines.tooMany', { max: MAX_STOCK_LINES }));
    } catch (error) {
      setProblem(errorText(failureOf(error instanceof Error ? error : null) ?? 'unknown_error'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t('salesReturns.challanPickerTitle')}
      description={t('salesReturns.challanPickerDescription')}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
        <PickProblem message={problem} />
        {challans?.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={DeliveryReturn01Icon}
            title={t('salesReturns.challanPickerEmpty')}
            description={t('salesReturns.challanPickerDescription')}
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid max-h-[min(420px,55dvh)] grid-cols-1 gap-px overflow-y-auto">
            {challans?.map((challan) => (
              <li
                key={challan.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 hover:bg-subtle"
              >
                <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="font-mono text-body-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
                    {challan.number ?? ''}
                  </span>
                  <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                    {isoDate(challan.date)} ·{' '}
                    {t('invoices.challanLines', { count: challan.lineCount })}
                    {challan.order?.number && ` · ${challan.order.number}`}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <PickButton
                  added={added.has(challan.id)}
                  loading={loading === challan.id}
                  onClick={() => void pick(challan.id)}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
```

- **A stock document with a customer**, like the delivery form of 15b: the lines are the stock line rows of step 13,
  in a `useFieldArray`, and the header is a card of boxes.
- **The warehouse box runs across the card**, with a hint for a damage or expiry store. Every item comes back into
  it (decision 3). From a challan it starts as the challan's warehouse, because goods that come back
  sound go back where they left; the store keeper changes it for expired strips. Without a challan, the only
  warehouse, or none.
- **The reason starts as the first one** ("Damaged"). A native select always shows one option, and the reason decides
  nothing in the books (15d.1), so an empty choice that blocks saving would only slow the store keeper down.
- **Two ways to add a line**, like the invoice:
  - **"Add from challans"** opens the customer's challans with goods that can still come back. Each click adds what
    is left on that challan (`returnableLines()`), and the dialog stays open: a pharmacy sends back strips of several
    deliveries in one carton.
  - **"Add items"** adds a line on its own, for goods that left before the system was used. The item picker allows
    archived products, as the API does (15d.3): an item the company stopped selling can still come back.
- **The rows say where each line came from.** A challan line shows "From DC-2026-27-0042 · Batch NP24117", what can
  still come back, and that the item and batch are the challan's. A line on its own says it comes back at the
  average cost (decision 2), so a cost on the stock card later is no surprise.
- **What can still come back is read from the challans themselves.** The form keeps the ids of the challans its
  lines came from (a draft's, the one it started from, the ones the picker added) and reads them through the query
  cache (`useQueries`). The return's own lines do not say what is left, and the challan does. The number is what
  posted returns left; this draft's own quantity is not counted until it is posted.
- **Another customer removes the challan lines** and keeps the lines on their own. The old customer's challan lines
  would only end in `return_delivery_line_invalid`; goods without a challan belong to no customer in particular.
- **`errors.line`** shows `return_cost_unknown` and the challan line errors under the item (see `StockLineRow`).
- **"Post return" saves and posts in one request**, as on the delivery form: the goods come into stock and the cost
  comes off the cost of goods sold, or nothing happens. The hint under the buttons says a return moves no money, for
  someone used to systems where it does.
- **The customer and date boxes are lazy chunks**, as on the delivery form: both bring the popover.

```tsx
import { Invoice04Icon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { isZeroQuantity, type SalesReturn, type SalesReturnLine } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { Button, Card, PageHeader } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { Link, useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';

import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { firstCreditableInvoice, returnReasonKey } from '../lib/returns';
import { Fact } from './adjustment-view';
import { EntryLinks } from './entry-links';
import { PrintButton, SalesReturnPrint } from './print-documents';
import {
  CustomerLink,
  DocumentNotice,
  LINK_NUMBER,
  LINK_ROW,
  LinkList,
  SalesBackLink,
} from './sales-parts';
import { DocumentStatusPill } from './sales-pills';
import { StockLinesTable } from './stock-lines-table';
import { useIsoDate, useQuantity, useWarehouses, warehouseLabel } from './stock-parts';

const LINK = 'font-medium text-brand underline-offset-3 hover:underline';

// A posted return (or a draft for someone who may not write returns), read only. A posted return
// never changes. Each line says where it came from, and whether the invoice had billed it when the
// return was posted: a billed line needs a credit note to give the money back, which the notice
// and "Write credit note" offer until every billed line is credited.
export function ReturnView({ salesReturn }: { salesReturn: SalesReturn }) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const quantity = useQuantity();
  const { byId } = useWarehouses();
  const canCredit = useCan()('sales.credit_note.manage');
  const posted = salesReturn.status === 'posted';
  // The challans by number: a line names its challan by number, the page links it by id
  const challanIds = new Map(salesReturn.deliveries.map((ref) => [ref.number, ref.id]));
  const creditable = posted && firstCreditableInvoice(salesReturn) !== null;
  const warehouse = warehouseLabel(byId.get(salesReturn.warehouseId));

  const detail = (line: SalesReturnLine) => {
    if (line.deliveryNumber === null) {
      return <span className="block text-caption text-ink-3">{t('salesReturns.ownLine')}</span>;
    }
    const challanId = challanIds.get(line.deliveryNumber);
    return (
      <span className="mt-1 grid gap-0.5 text-caption text-ink-3">
        {challanId === undefined ? (
          <span>{t('salesReturns.fromChallan', { number: line.deliveryNumber })}</span>
        ) : (
          <Link to="/deliveries/$deliveryId" params={{ deliveryId: challanId }} className={LINK}>
            {t('salesReturns.fromChallan', { number: line.deliveryNumber })}
          </Link>
        )}
        {/* Fixed when the return was posted; a draft has not looked yet */}
        {posted &&
          (line.invoiceId !== null && line.invoiceNumber !== null ? (
            <Link to="/invoices/$invoiceId" params={{ invoiceId: line.invoiceId }} className={LINK}>
              {t('salesReturns.lineBilled', { number: line.invoiceNumber })}
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <span>{t('salesReturns.lineNotBilled')}</span>
          ))}
        {!isZeroQuantity(line.creditedQuantity) && (
          <span className="tabular-nums">
            {t('salesReturns.lineCredited', {
              quantity: quantity(line.creditedQuantity, line.baseUnitId),
            })}
          </span>
        )}
      </span>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <SalesBackLink to="/sales-returns" label={t('salesReturns.back')} />
      <PageHeader
        title={salesReturn.number ?? t('salesReturns.draftTitle')}
        description={salesReturn.customer.name}
        actions={
          <>
            <DocumentStatusPill
              status={salesReturn.status}
              label={t(`salesReturns.statuses.${salesReturn.status}`)}
            />
            {posted && <PrintButton />}
          </>
        }
      />
      {creditable && (
        <DocumentNotice tone="neutral">{t('salesReturns.creditNotice')}</DocumentNotice>
      )}
      <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-4 p-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-0.5">
          <span className="text-caption font-medium text-ink-3">{t('salesReturns.customer')}</span>
          <span className="text-body-sm">
            <CustomerLink customer={salesReturn.customer} />
          </span>
        </div>
        <Fact label={t('salesReturns.date')} value={isoDate(salesReturn.date)} />
        <Fact label={t('salesReturns.reason')} value={t(returnReasonKey(salesReturn.reason))} />
        <Fact label={t('salesReturns.warehouse')} value={warehouse} />
        {salesReturn.postedAt !== null && (
          <Fact
            label={t('salesReturns.statuses.posted')}
            // A moment, not a date: shown in the reader's own time zone
            value={t('salesReturns.postedOn', {
              date: format.date(new Date(salesReturn.postedAt)),
            })}
          />
        )}
        {posted && (
          <EntryLinks
            label={t('salesReturns.entry')}
            entries={salesReturn.entry ? [salesReturn.entry] : []}
            none={t('salesReturns.noEntry')}
          />
        )}
        {salesReturn.note !== null && (
          <div className="sm:col-span-3">
            <Fact label={t('salesReturns.note')} value={salesReturn.note} />
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
      <StockLinesTable lines={salesReturn.lines} detail={detail} />

      {posted && (
```
