```tsx
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
          {salesReturn.deliveries.length > 0 && (
            <LinkList
              title={t('salesReturns.challansTitle')}
              subtitle={t('salesReturns.challansSubtitle')}
            >
              {salesReturn.deliveries.map((challan) => (
                <li key={challan.id}>
                  <Link
                    to="/deliveries/$deliveryId"
                    params={{ deliveryId: challan.id }}
                    className={LINK_ROW}
                  >
                    <span className={LINK_NUMBER}>{challan.number ?? ''}</span>
                  </Link>
                </li>
              ))}
            </LinkList>
          )}
          {/* Drafts too (15d.1), so nobody writes a second credit note by mistake */}
          <LinkList
            title={t('salesReturns.creditNotesTitle')}
            subtitle={t('salesReturns.creditNotesSubtitle')}
            empty={
              salesReturn.creditNotes.length === 0 ? t('salesReturns.noCreditNotes') : undefined
            }
          >
            {salesReturn.creditNotes.map((note) => (
              <li key={note.id}>
                <Link
                  to="/credit-notes/$creditNoteId"
                  params={{ creditNoteId: note.id }}
                  className={LINK_ROW}
                >
                  <span className={LINK_NUMBER}>
                    {note.number ?? t('creditNotes.statuses.draft')}
                  </span>
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </LinkList>
        </div>
      )}

      {creditable && canCredit && (
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <Button
            onClick={() =>
              void navigate({ to: '/credit-notes/new', search: { returnId: salesReturn.id } })
            }
          >
            <HugeiconsIcon icon={Invoice04Icon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
            {t('salesReturns.makeCreditNote')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
      {posted && <SalesReturnPrint salesReturn={salesReturn} warehouse={warehouse} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **Each line says where it came from** in the detail cell: the challan (a link, found by number in the return's
  `deliveries`), then, once posted, whether the invoice had billed it ("Billed on INV-…" linking to the invoice, or
  "Not billed yet: the invoice bills less"), and what credit notes gave back. A draft does not say billed or not: the
  answer is fixed only at posting (15d.2).
- **The credit notice and "Write credit note"** show while billed goods are not all credited
  (`firstCreditableInvoice()`). The notice is neutral, not `warn`: nothing is late or wrong, the money is simply
  still to be given back.
- **The credit notes card lists drafts too** (15d.1), with "Draft" for a number. Someone about to write a credit note
  sees that one is already waiting.
- **The print sheet gets the warehouse's name** from the page, which already has the warehouses: the print file
  stays free of the warehouse query.

```tsx
import { AlertCircleIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { EmptyState } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useParams, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';

import { SalesBackLink } from '../components/sales-parts';
import { useTenantId, useToday, useWarehouses } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { deliveryQuery, salesReturnQuery, unitsQuery } from '../lib/queries';

// The page loads the data and picks the form or the view, each a lazy chunk of its own (the
// delivery's pattern)
const ReturnForm = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/return-form')).ReturnForm,
}));
const ReturnView = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/return-view')).ReturnView,
}));

// The units and the warehouses: the lines and the warehouse box need them
function useReady(): boolean {
  const units = useQuery(unitsQuery(useTenantId())).data;
  const { active } = useWarehouses();
  return units !== undefined && active !== undefined;
}

function CantFind({ message }: { message: string }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <SalesBackLink to="/sales-returns" label={t('salesReturns.back')} />
      <EmptyState icon={AlertCircleIcon} title={t('salesReturns.title')} description={message} />
    </div>
  );
}

// A new return; "Take goods back" on a challan comes here with ?deliveryId=
export function NewSalesReturnPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const canWrite = useCan()('sales.return.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { deliveryId = '' } = useSearch({ strict: false });
  const { data: delivery, isError } = useQuery({
    ...deliveryQuery(useTenantId(), deliveryId),
    enabled: deliveryId !== '',
  });
  if (!canWrite) {
    return (
      <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
        <SalesBackLink to="/sales-returns" label={t('salesReturns.back')} />
        <p className="text-body-sm text-ink-3">{t('salesReturns.cantWrite')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (isError) return <CantFind message={t('deliveries.notFound')} />;
  // The form waits for the challan: drawing it empty and filling it a moment later would let the
  // person type into a form that is about to be replaced
  if (!ready || (deliveryId !== '' && !delivery)) return null;
  // Only a posted challan's goods can come back; a draft's start the form empty
  const posted = delivery?.status === 'posted' ? delivery : null;
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <ReturnForm salesReturn={null} delivery={posted} today={today} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

export function SalesReturnPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const { returnId = '' } = useParams({ strict: false });
  const canWrite = useCan()('sales.return.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { data: salesReturn, isError } = useQuery({
    ...salesReturnQuery(useTenantId(), returnId),
    enabled: returnId !== '',
  });

  if (isError) return <CantFind message={t('salesReturns.notFound')} />;
  if (!salesReturn || !ready) return null;
  if (salesReturn.status === 'draft' && canWrite) {
    // key: a saved draft comes back with a new version, and the form starts from it again
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        <ReturnForm
          key={`${salesReturn.id}-${String(salesReturn.version)}`}
          salesReturn={salesReturn}
          delivery={null}
          today={today}
        />
      </Suspense>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <ReturnView salesReturn={salesReturn} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

- **The delivery page's pattern**: the route loads the data, then shows the form (a draft, for someone with
  `sales.return.manage`) or the view, each a lazy chunk.
- **"Take goods back" waits for the challan** before drawing the form, so nobody types into a form that is about to
  be refilled. A draft challan starts the form empty: only posted goods can come back.

```tsx
import { DeliveryReturn01Icon, PlusSignIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import {
  type SalesReturnSummary,
  STOCK_DOCUMENT_STATUSES,
  type StockDocumentStatus,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  DataTable,
  dataTableColumns,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  SegmentedControl,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useInfiniteQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { CustomerPicker } from '../components/customer-picker';
import { DocumentStatusPill } from '../components/sales-pills';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId, useWarehouses, warehouseLabel } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { salesReturnsQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { returnReasonKey } from '../lib/returns';

const column = dataTableColumns<SalesReturnSummary>();

// The sales returns (step 15d): what came back, from whom, why and into which warehouse
export function SalesReturnsPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const canWrite = useCan()('sales.return.manage');
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const { byId } = useWarehouses();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<StockDocumentStatus | ''>('');
  const [customerId, setCustomerId] = useState('');
  const { data, isError, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage } = useInfiniteQuery(
    salesReturnsQuery(useTenantId(), { status, customerId }),
  );
  const rows = useMemo(() => data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.items), [data]);
  const loadMore = useCallback(() => {
    if (hasNextPage && !isFetchingNextPage) void fetchNextPage();
  }, [hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage]);

  const columns = useMemo(
    () =>
      column.columns([
        column.accessor('number', {
          header: t('salesReturns.columns.number'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'title' },
          cell: ({ row }) => (
            <span className="grid">
              <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums">
                {row.original.number ?? t('salesReturns.statuses.draft')}
              </span>
              <span className="text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                {isoDate(row.original.date)}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor((salesReturn) => salesReturn.customer.name, {
          id: 'customer',
          header: t('salesReturns.columns.customer'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'subtitle' },
          cell: ({ row }) => (
            <span className="grid min-w-0 max-w-[18rem]">
              <span className="truncate">{row.original.customer.name}</span>
              <span className="truncate font-mono text-caption text-ink-3">
                {row.original.customer.code}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor('reason', {
          header: t('salesReturns.columns.reason'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'detail' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => t(returnReasonKey(getValue())),
        }),
        column.accessor('warehouseId', {
          header: t('salesReturns.columns.warehouse'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'detail' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => warehouseLabel(byId.get(getValue())),
        }),
        column.accessor('lineCount', {
          header: t('salesReturns.columns.lines'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { align: 'end', card: 'detail' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => t('salesLines.lineCount', { count: getValue() }),
        }),
        column.accessor('status', {
          header: t('salesReturns.columns.status'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'trailing' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => (
            <DocumentStatusPill
              status={getValue()}
              label={t(`salesReturns.statuses.${getValue()}`)}
            />
          ),
        }),
      ]),
    [t, isoDate, byId],
  );

  const write = canWrite && (
    <Button onClick={() => void navigate({ to: '/sales-returns/new' })}>
      <HugeiconsIcon icon={PlusSignIcon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
      {t('salesReturns.new')}
    </Button>
  );

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PageHeader
        title={t('salesReturns.title')}
        description={t('salesReturns.description')}
        actions={write}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 basis-72">
          <CustomerPicker
            id="sales-returns-customer"
            aria-label={t('salesReturns.customer')}
            value={customerId}
            saved={null}
            onChange={setCustomerId}
            allLabel={t('customers.allCustomers')}
          />
        </div>
        <SegmentedControl
          label={t('salesReturns.show')}
          value={status}
          options={[
            { value: '', label: t('salesReturns.all') },
            ...STOCK_DOCUMENT_STATUSES.map((value) => ({
              value,
              label: t(`salesReturns.statuses.${value}`),
            })),
          ]}
          onChange={setStatus}
        />
      </div>
      {isError && <p className="text-body-sm text-crit">{t('salesReturns.loadFailed')}</p>}
      {rows && (
        <DataTable
          label={t('salesReturns.title')}
          data={rows}
          columns={columns}
          getRowId={(row) => row.id}
          onRowClick={(row) =>
            void navigate({ to: '/sales-returns/$returnId', params: { returnId: row.id } })
          }
          onEndReached={loadMore}
          empty={
            <EmptyState
              icon={DeliveryReturn01Icon}
              title={t('salesReturns.emptyTitle')}
              description={t('salesReturns.emptyBody')}
              action={write}
            />
          }
          footer={
            isFetchingNextPage && (
              <p className="text-caption text-ink-3">{t('common.loadingMore')}</p>
            )
          }
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **The columns a store keeper scans**: number and date, customer, reason, the warehouse the goods came into, how
  many items, and the status. The reason uses `returnReasonKey()`, so a reason this app does not know reads "Other".

### Credit notes: `credit-note-lines.tsx`, `credit-note-form.tsx`, `credit-note-view.tsx` and their routes (new)

```tsx
import {
  Alert02Icon,
  Delete02Icon,
  DeliveryReturn01Icon,
  InvoiceIcon,
} from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import {
  compareMoney,
  type CreditNoteLineFormValues,
  defaultLineDescription,
  documentTotals,
  draftLineAmounts,
  type Invoice,
  type InvoiceLine,
  isMoneyAmount,
  type LineAmounts,
  MAX_INVOICE_LINES,
  priceInUnit,
  wholeInvoiceCreditLines,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  cn,
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DiscountInput,
  EmptyState,
  IconButton,
  Input,
  MoneyInput,
  Select,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { FieldErrors } from 'react-hook-form';

import { postedReturnsQuery, salesReturnQuery, unitsQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { creditableReturnLines, creditLeft, returnLineToCredit } from '../lib/returns';
import { basePreview, unitChoices } from '../lib/stock';
import { useRateText } from '../lib/tax-rates';
import { failureOf } from './journal-parts';
import { FixedValue, SALES_LINE_COLUMNS, SalesField } from './sales-line-editor';
import { PickButton, PickProblem, SalesTotals } from './sales-parts';
import { useIsoDate, useQuantity, useTenantId, VariantCell } from './stock-parts';

// The lines of a credit note (step 15d): the sales line editor's grid and boxes, but every line
// takes back a line of the chosen invoice. The item and the VAT rate are that line's (the VAT taken
// back is the VAT charged), so they are shown, not picked; the unit, quantity, price and discount
// can change (3 strips back from a line of 2 boxes; a price cut of ৳2 a strip). Lines come only from
// the two pickers: an invoice line, or goods that came back on a return. Its own chunk, loaded by
// the credit note form.

export type CreditNoteLinesErrors = FieldErrors<{ lines: CreditNoteLineFormValues[] }>['lines'];

let lastKey = 0;
function nextKey(): string {
  lastKey += 1;
  return `credit-${String(lastKey)}`;
}

// A unit's size in the base unit: "1" for the base unit itself
function factorOf(line: InvoiceLine, unitId: string): string | null {
  if (unitId === line.baseUnitId) return '1';
  return line.units.find((unit) => unit.unitId === unitId)?.factor ?? null;
}

export function CreditNoteLinesEditor({
  lines,
  onChange,
  getLines,
  invoice,
  customerId,
  returnNumbers,
  onReturnNumbers,
  errors,
}: {
  lines: CreditNoteLineFormValues[];
  onChange: (lines: CreditNoteLineFormValues[]) => void;
  // The form's lines right now (getValues): a picker that waited for the API appends to these
  getLines: () => CreditNoteLineFormValues[];
  // The chosen invoice with its lines; null until one is picked
  invoice: Invoice | null;
  customerId: string;
  // The return number of each return line on the form, for "Goods back on SR-…"
  returnNumbers: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
  onReturnNumbers: (entries: readonly (readonly [string, string])[]) => void;
  errors: CreditNoteLinesErrors;
}) {
  const { t, format, errorText } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const quantityText = useQuantity();
  const rateText = useRateText();
  const units = useQuery(unitsQuery(tenantId)).data ?? [];
  // React's key for each line: stays with the line when a line above it is removed
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<string[]>(() => lines.map(() => nextKey()));
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState<'lines' | 'returns' | null>(null);
  const invoiceLines = new Map(invoice?.lines.map((line) => [line.id, line]));
  const pricesIncludeVat = invoice?.pricesIncludeVat ?? false;
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });

  // Worked out like the API: the invoice's own pricing, the invoice line's VAT rate
  const amounts = lines.map((line) => {
    const source = invoiceLines.get(line.invoiceLineId);
    return source
      ? draftLineAmounts(
          {
            quantity: line.quantity,
            unitPrice: line.unitPrice,
            discountType: line.discountType,
            discount: line.discount,
          },
          source.taxRate.rate,
          pricesIncludeVat,
        )
      : null;
  });
  const totals = documentTotals(amounts.filter((amount): amount is LineAmounts => amount !== null));

  // Lines from a picker. false = the credit note would hold too many; nothing is added.
  const add = (added: readonly CreditNoteLineFormValues[]): boolean => {
    if (getLines().length + added.length > MAX_INVOICE_LINES) return false;
    onChange([...getLines(), ...added]);
    setKeys((before) => [...before, ...added.map(() => nextKey())]);
    return true;
  };

  const remove = (index: number) => {
    onChange(lines.filter((_, at) => at !== index));
    setKeys((before) => before.filter((_, at) => at !== index));
  };

  const update = (index: number, patch: Partial<CreditNoteLineFormValues>) => {
    onChange(lines.map((line, at) => (at === index ? { ...line, ...patch } : line)));
  };

  // A price is per unit, so another unit moves the typed price with it: ৳120 a box is ৳12 a strip.
  // A price being typed stays as it is.
  const changeUnit = (index: number, unitId: string) => {
    const line = lines[index];
    const source = line ? invoiceLines.get(line.invoiceLineId) : undefined;
    if (!line || !source) return;
    const from = factorOf(source, line.unitId);
    const to = factorOf(source, unitId);
    const price = line.unitPrice.trim();
    update(index, {
      unitId,
      ...(from !== null && to !== null && isMoneyAmount(price)
        ? { unitPrice: priceInUnit(price, from, to) }
        : {}),
    });
  };

  const listError = errors?.root?.message ?? errors?.message;

  return (
    <Card
      className="@container grid grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden"
      aria-label={t('salesLines.items')}
    >
      {lines.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-5 py-6 text-body-sm text-ink-2">{t('salesLines.noLines')}</p>
      ) : (
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn(
            'hidden bg-subtle px-5 py-2 text-caption font-medium text-ink-3 @5xl:grid',
            SALES_LINE_COLUMNS,
          )}
        >
          <span>{t('salesLines.item')}</span>
          <span>{t('salesLines.unit')}</span>
          <span className="text-right">{t('salesLines.quantity')}</span>
          <span className="text-right">
            {pricesIncludeVat ? t('salesLines.priceWithVat') : t('salesLines.priceWithoutVat')}
          </span>
          <span className="text-right">{t('salesLines.discount')}</span>
          <span>{t('salesLines.vatRate')}</span>
          <span className="text-right">{t('salesLines.amount')}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {lines.map((line, index) => {
        const source = invoiceLines.get(line.invoiceLineId);
        const key = keys[index] ?? `line-${String(index)}`;
        if (!source) return null;
        const number = index + 1;
        const lineErrors = errors?.[index];
        const id = (field: string) => `lines.${String(index)}.${field}`;
        const preview = basePreview(source, line.unitId, line.quantity, units);
        const amount = amounts[index];
        const returnLineId = line.returnLineId ?? '';
        // The line's own problem: not a line of this invoice, or a return line it cannot credit
        const lineError = lineErrors?.invoiceLineId?.message ?? lineErrors?.returnLineId?.message;
        const removeButton = (
          <IconButton
            icon={Delete02Icon}
            label={t('salesLines.remove', { number })}
            onClick={() => {
              remove(index);
            }}
          />
        );
        return (
          <div
            key={key}
            role="group"
            aria-label={t('salesLines.line', { number })}
            className={cn(
              'grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-line px-5 py-4',
              SALES_LINE_COLUMNS,
            )}
          >
            <div className="col-span-2 grid min-w-0 gap-2 @5xl:col-span-1">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <VariantCell item={source} />
                <span className="@5xl:hidden">{removeButton}</span>
              </div>
              <span className="grid gap-0.5 text-caption text-ink-3">
                <span className="font-medium text-ink-2">
                  {returnLineId === ''
                    ? t('creditNotes.fromInvoiceLine', {
                        number: (invoice?.lines.indexOf(source) ?? 0) + 1,
                      })
                    : t('creditNotes.fromReturn', {
                        number: returnNumbers.get(returnLineId) ?? '',
                      })}
                </span>
                {/* The money cap of 15d.1: what posted credit notes left on the invoice line */}
                <span className="tabular-nums">
                  {t('creditNotes.leftToCredit', { amount: money(creditLeft(source)) })}
                </span>
                {lineError && (
                  <span className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-label text-crit">
                    <HugeiconsIcon
                      icon={Alert02Icon}
                      size={15}
                      strokeWidth={1.5}
                      className="mt-px shrink-0"
                    />
                    {errorText(lineError)}
                  </span>
                )}
              </span>
              <SalesField
                id={id('description')}
                label={t('salesLines.description')}
                error={lineErrors?.description?.message}
              >
                <Input
                  id={id('description')}
                  autoComplete="off"
                  placeholder={defaultLineDescription(source)}
                  value={line.description ?? ''}
                  invalid={lineErrors?.description !== undefined}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    update(index, { description: event.target.value });
                  }}
                />
              </SalesField>
            </div>
            <SalesField
              id={id('unitId')}
              label={t('salesLines.unit')}
              error={lineErrors?.unitId?.message}
            >
              <Select
                id={id('unitId')}
                options={unitChoices(source, units)}
                value={line.unitId}
                invalid={lineErrors?.unitId !== undefined}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  changeUnit(index, event.target.value);
                }}
              />
            </SalesField>
            <SalesField
              id={id('quantity')}
              label={t('salesLines.quantity')}
              error={lineErrors?.quantity?.message}
            >
              <Input
                id={id('quantity')}
                inputMode="decimal"
                autoComplete="off"
                align="end"
                value={line.quantity}
                invalid={lineErrors?.quantity !== undefined}
                aria-describedby={lineErrors?.quantity ? `${id('quantity')}-error` : undefined}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  update(index, { quantity: event.target.value });
                }}
              />
              {preview !== null && (
                <span className="text-right text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                  {t('stockLines.equals', { quantity: quantityText(preview, source.baseUnitId) })}
                </span>
              )}
            </SalesField>
            <SalesField
              id={id('unitPrice')}
              label={
                pricesIncludeVat ? t('salesLines.priceWithVat') : t('salesLines.priceWithoutVat')
              }
              error={lineErrors?.unitPrice?.message}
            >
              <MoneyInput
                id={id('unitPrice')}
                value={line.unitPrice}
                invalid={lineErrors?.unitPrice !== undefined}
                aria-describedby={lineErrors?.unitPrice ? `${id('unitPrice')}-error` : undefined}
                onChange={(value) => {
                  update(index, { unitPrice: value });
                }}
              />
            </SalesField>
            <SalesField
              id={id('discount')}
              label={t('salesLines.discount')}
              error={lineErrors?.discount?.message}
            >
              <DiscountInput
                id={id('discount')}
                value={line.discount}
                discountType={line.discountType}
                invalid={lineErrors?.discount !== undefined}
                aria-describedby={lineErrors?.discount ? `${id('discount')}-error` : undefined}
                onChange={(value) => {
                  update(index, { discount: value });
                }}
                onDiscountTypeChange={(discountType) => {
                  update(index, { discountType });
                }}
              />
            </SalesField>
            <FixedValue
              label={t('salesLines.vatRate')}
              value={`${source.taxRate.name} · ${rateText(source.taxRate.rate)}`}
            />
            <div className="grid content-start gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-label font-medium text-ink @5xl:sr-only">
                {t('salesLines.amount')}
              </span>
              <span className="py-2.5 text-right text-body-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
                {amount ? money(pricesIncludeVat ? amount.total : amount.net) : '—'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="hidden @5xl:block @5xl:pt-1">{removeButton}</div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
      {listError && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-line px-5 py-3 text-label text-crit">
          <HugeiconsIcon icon={Alert02Icon} size={15} strokeWidth={1.5} className="shrink-0" />
          {errorText(listError)}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line px-5 py-3">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="sm"
          disabled={invoice === null}
          onClick={() => {
            setPicking('lines');
          }}
        >
          <HugeiconsIcon icon={InvoiceIcon} size={16} strokeWidth={1.5} />
          {t('creditNotes.addInvoiceLines')}
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="sm"
          disabled={invoice === null}
          onClick={() => {
            setPicking('returns');
          }}
        >
          <HugeiconsIcon icon={DeliveryReturn01Icon} size={16} strokeWidth={1.5} />
          {t('creditNotes.addReturns')}
        </Button>
        {invoice === null && (
          <span className="text-label text-ink-3">{t('creditNotes.pickInvoiceFirst')}</span>
        )}
      </div>
      {lines.length > 0 && <SalesTotals totals={totals} pricesIncludeVat={pricesIncludeVat} />}

      <Dialog
        open={picking !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setPicking(null);
        }}
      >
        {picking === 'lines' && invoice && <InvoiceLinePicker invoice={invoice} add={add} />}
        {picking === 'returns' && invoice && (
          <ReturnPicker
            invoice={invoice}
            customerId={customerId}
            onForm={
              new Set(
                lines.flatMap((line) => {
                  const id = line.returnLineId ?? '';
                  return id === '' ? [] : [id];
                }),
              )
            }
            add={add}
            onReturnNumbers={onReturnNumbers}
          />
        )}
      </Dialog>
    </Card>
  );
}

// "Add invoice lines": a line of the invoice as it was billed, for a price cut (keep the quantity,
// type the cut per unit) or goods that came back without a return in the system. Lines taken back
// in full are left out.
function InvoiceLinePicker({
  invoice,
  add,
}: {
  invoice: Invoice;
  add: (lines: readonly CreditNoteLineFormValues[]) => boolean;
}) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const quantity = useQuantity();
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const open = invoice.lines.filter((line) => compareMoney(creditLeft(line), '0') > 0);

  const pick = (line: InvoiceLine) => {
    setProblem(null);
    if (add(wholeInvoiceCreditLines({ lines: [line] }))) {
      setAdded((before) => new Set(before).add(line.id));
    } else {
      setProblem(t('salesLines.tooMany', { max: MAX_INVOICE_LINES }));
    }
  };

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t('creditNotes.invoiceLinePickerTitle')}
      description={t('creditNotes.invoiceLinePickerDescription')}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
        <PickProblem message={problem} />
        {open.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={InvoiceIcon}
            title={t('creditNotes.invoiceLinePickerEmpty')}
            description={t('creditNotes.invoiceLinePickerDescription')}
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid max-h-[min(420px,55dvh)] grid-cols-1 gap-px overflow-y-auto">
            {open.map((line) => (
              <li
                key={line.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 hover:bg-subtle"
              >
                <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="truncate text-body-sm font-medium">{line.description}</span>
                  <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                    {t('creditNotes.fromInvoiceLine', { number: invoice.lines.indexOf(line) + 1 })}{' '}
                    · {quantity(line.quantity, line.unitId)} ·{' '}
                    {t('creditNotes.leftToCredit', {
                      amount: format.money(creditLeft(line), { decimals: 2 }),
                    })}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <PickButton
                  added={added.has(line.id)}
                  loading={false}
                  onClick={() => {
                    pick(line);
                  }}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}

// "Add returned goods": the customer's posted returns. A click opens the return and adds its lines
// that this invoice billed and credit notes have not given the money back for, at the invoice's
// price. The list cannot say which returns hold such lines, so one with none says so when opened.
function ReturnPicker({
  invoice,
  customerId,
  onForm,
  add,
  onReturnNumbers,
}: {
  invoice: Invoice;
  customerId: string;
  onForm: ReadonlySet<string>;
  add: (lines: readonly CreditNoteLineFormValues[]) => boolean;
  onReturnNumbers: (entries: readonly (readonly [string, string])[]) => void;
}) {
  const { t, errorText } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const { data: returns } = useQuery(postedReturnsQuery(tenantId, customerId));
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const invoiceLines = new Map(invoice.lines.map((line) => [line.id, line]));

  const pick = async (returnId: string) => {
    setLoading(returnId);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      const salesReturn = await queryClient.query(salesReturnQuery(tenantId, returnId));
      const lines = creditableReturnLines(salesReturn, invoice.id, onForm).flatMap((line) => {
        const source = invoiceLines.get(line.invoiceLineId ?? '');
        return source ? [{ line, credit: returnLineToCredit(line, source) }] : [];
      });
      if (lines.length === 0) {
        setProblem(t('creditNotes.returnPickerEmpty'));
        return;
      }
      if (!add(lines.map((entry) => entry.credit))) {
        setProblem(t('salesLines.tooMany', { max: MAX_INVOICE_LINES }));
        return;
      }
      onReturnNumbers(lines.map((entry) => [entry.line.id, salesReturn.number ?? ''] as const));
      setAdded((before) => new Set(before).add(returnId));
    } catch (error) {
      setProblem(errorText(failureOf(error instanceof Error ? error : null) ?? 'unknown_error'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <DialogContent
      title={t('creditNotes.returnPickerTitle')}
      description={t('creditNotes.returnPickerDescription')}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
        <PickProblem message={problem} />
        {returns?.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={DeliveryReturn01Icon}
            title={t('creditNotes.returnPickerEmpty')}
            description={t('creditNotes.returnPickerDescription')}
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid max-h-[min(420px,55dvh)] grid-cols-1 gap-px overflow-y-auto">
            {returns?.map((salesReturn) => (
              <li
                key={salesReturn.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 hover:bg-subtle"
              >
                <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="font-mono text-body-sm font-medium tabular-nums">
                    {salesReturn.number ?? ''}
                  </span>
                  <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                    {isoDate(salesReturn.date)} ·{' '}
                    {t('salesLines.lineCount', { count: salesReturn.lineCount })}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <PickButton
                  added={added.has(salesReturn.id)}
                  loading={loading === salesReturn.id}
                  onClick={() => void pick(salesReturn.id)}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
```

- **Its own editor, on the sales editor's grid.** A credit note line has no item and no VAT rate of its own: both are
  the invoice line's (15d.1). The sales editor (`LinesEditor`) is built around a line that picks both, looks up
  prices for the customer and offers to reprice, and a credit note must do none of that. Bending it with more
  options would make the quotation's editor harder to read. This editor shares the grid (`SALES_LINE_COLUMNS`), the
  boxes and the totals, so both look the same.
- **The item and the VAT rate are shown, not picked.** The VAT is shown as the invoice line charged it ("VAT 15% ·
  15%"), because the VAT taken back must be the VAT charged.
- **The unit can change, and the price moves with it**: ৳120 a box becomes ৳12 a strip, so "3 strips back from a
  line of 2 boxes" needs no arithmetic. A price being typed (not an amount yet) is left alone.
- **The amounts are worked out like the API's**: `draftLineAmounts()` with the invoice line's rate and the
  invoice's own `pricesIncludeVat` (15d.1). The totals under the lines are the totals the credit note will post.
- **Under each line**: which invoice line it takes back ("Line 2 of the invoice"), or which return ("Goods back on
  SR-…"), and what is left on that invoice line (`creditLeft()`). A problem with the line itself
  (`credit_note_line_invalid`, `credit_note_return_invalid`) shows there too. `credit_note_over_line` shows under the
  price, where the server puts it (15d.3).
- **Keys of their own** (`keys` beside the lines), like the sales editor's `meta`: React keeps a removed line's
  boxes from moving to the next line.
- **Two pickers, no "Add items"**: a credit note takes back what was billed, so every line comes from the invoice.
  - **"Add invoice lines"** adds a line as it was billed (`wholeInvoiceCreditLines()` for one line). For a price
    cut, the person keeps the quantity and types the cut per unit as the price, which the dialog's description says.
    Lines taken back in full are not offered. A partly credited line is offered as billed too: the limit under it
    says how much is left, and the person lowers the line. (The 15d.5 text said "with what can still be taken
    back"; it now says this.)
  - **"Add returned goods"** lists the customer's posted returns. A click opens the return and adds the goods this
    invoice billed that are not credited yet, at the invoice's prices (`returnLineToCredit()`). A return with none
    says so in the dialog. The return numbers go back to the form, so each line can say "Goods back on SR-…".
- **Both pickers wait for the invoice**: without it there is nothing to take back, and the buttons say so.

```tsx
import { Calendar03Icon, Delete02Icon, UserIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  contractErrorMap,
  type CreditNote,
  type CreditNoteFormValues,
  type CreditNoteLineFormValues,
  creditNoteIsLate,
  type CreditNoteReason,
  CREDIT_NOTE_REASONS,
  type Invoice,
  routes,
  updateCreditNoteInputSchema,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  Field,
  FormAlert,
  FormField,
  Input,
  PageHeader,
  SelectField,
  TextField,
  toast,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useMutation, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense, useState } from 'react';
import { Controller, type Path, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import { ApiRequestError, call } from '../lib/api';
import { applyApiError } from '../lib/field-errors';
import { rowPath } from '../lib/products';
import { invoiceQuery, postedInvoicesQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { creditReasonKey, toCreditFormLine } from '../lib/returns';
import { failureOf } from './journal-parts';
import { DocumentNotice, SalesBackLink, useSalesRefresh } from './sales-parts';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// The credit note form (step 15d): its own chunk, loaded by routes/credit-note.tsx. The customer,
// then one of their posted invoices, then the lines that take part of it back.

// The lines editor, the customer box and the date box as chunks of their own, like the invoice
// form's: they bring the money boxes and the popover
const CreditNoteLinesEditor = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./credit-note-lines')).CreditNoteLinesEditor,
}));
const CustomerPicker = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./customer-picker')).CustomerPicker,
}));
const DatePicker = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./date-input')).DatePicker }));

type FormValues = CreditNoteFormValues;

function fieldNames(count: number): Path<FormValues>[] {
  return [
    'invoiceId',
    'date',
    'reason',
    'note',
    'lines',
    ...Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => [
      rowPath('lines', index, 'invoiceLineId'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'returnLineId'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'unitId'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'quantity'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'description'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'unitPrice'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'discountType'),
      rowPath('lines', index, 'discount'),
    ]).flat(),
  ];
}

// What a new credit note starts with: "Write credit note" on an invoice (no lines) or on a return
// (that return's lines billed on its first invoice still to credit)
export interface CreditNoteStart {
  invoice: Invoice;
  lines: CreditNoteLineFormValues[];
  returnNumbers: readonly (readonly [string, string])[];
  reason: CreditNoteReason;
}

// Writing a new credit note, or changing a draft. "Save draft" keeps it a draft; "Post credit note"
// saves and posts in one request: the sale, its VAT and what the customer owes are taken back, and
// its money pays the invoice, all or nothing.
export function CreditNoteForm({
  creditNote,
  start,
  today,
}: {
  creditNote: CreditNote | null;
  start: CreditNoteStart | null;
  today: string;
}) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const refresh = useSalesRefresh();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const savedCustomer = creditNote?.customer ?? start?.invoice.customer ?? null;
  // Not sent: the server takes the customer from the invoice (15d.1). The box narrows the invoices.
  const [customerId, setCustomerId] = useState(savedCustomer?.id ?? '');
  const [returnNumbers, setReturnNumbers] = useState<ReadonlyMap<string, string>>(
    () =>
      new Map([
        ...(creditNote?.lines ?? []).flatMap((line) =>
          line.returnLineId !== null && line.returnNumber !== null
            ? [[line.returnLineId, line.returnNumber] as const]
            : [],
        ),
        ...(start?.returnNumbers ?? []),
      ]),
  );
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    setValue,
    getValues,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(updateCreditNoteInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: {
      invoiceId: creditNote?.invoice.id ?? start?.invoice.id ?? '',
      date: creditNote?.date ?? today,
      reason:
        CREDIT_NOTE_REASONS.find((reason) => reason === creditNote?.reason) ??
        start?.reason ??
        'price_adjustment',
      note: creditNote?.note ?? '',
      lines: creditNote?.lines.map(toCreditFormLine) ?? start?.lines ?? [],
      post: false,
      version: creditNote?.version ?? 1,
    },
  });
  const invoiceId = useWatch({ control, name: 'invoiceId' });
  const date = useWatch({ control, name: 'date' });
  const lines = useWatch({ control, name: 'lines' });
  const invoice =
    useQuery({ ...invoiceQuery(tenantId, invoiceId), enabled: invoiceId !== '' }).data ?? null;
  const postedInvoices = useQuery({
    ...postedInvoicesQuery(tenantId, customerId),
    enabled: customerId !== '',
  }).data;
  // Lines of one invoice never sit under another: both boxes wait until the lines are gone
  const locked = lines.length > 0;
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });

  // The invoice box: the customer's posted invoices, and the draft's own invoice when it is older
  // than the 100 the list reads
  const invoiceOptions = [
    {
      value: '',
      label:
        customerId === ''
          ? t('creditNotes.pickCustomerFirst')
          : t('creditNotes.invoicePlaceholder'),
    },
    ...(postedInvoices ?? []).map((posted) => ({
      value: posted.id,
      label: t('creditNotes.invoiceOption', {
        number: posted.number ?? '',
        date: isoDate(posted.date),
        total: money(posted.total),
      }),
    })),
    ...(creditNote !== null &&
    customerId === creditNote.customer.id &&
    !(postedInvoices ?? []).some((posted) => posted.id === creditNote.invoice.id)
      ? [{ value: creditNote.invoice.id, label: creditNote.invoice.number }]
      : []),
  ];
  const invoiceHint = locked
    ? t('creditNotes.invoiceLocked')
    : customerId !== '' && postedInvoices?.length === 0
      ? t('creditNotes.noInvoices')
      : t('creditNotes.invoiceHint');
  const late = invoice !== null && date !== '' && creditNoteIsLate(invoice.date, date);

  const save = (post: boolean) =>
    handleSubmit(async ({ version, ...values }) => {
      try {
        const body = { ...values, post };
        const saved = creditNote
          ? await call(routes.creditNotes.update, {
              params: { id: creditNote.id },
              body: { ...body, version },
            })
          : await call(routes.creditNotes.create, { body });
        await refresh();
        toast(
          saved.status === 'posted'
            ? t('creditNotes.posted', { number: saved.number ?? '' })
            : t('creditNotes.draftSaved'),
        );
        if (!creditNote) {
          void navigate({
            to: '/credit-notes/$creditNoteId',
            params: { creditNoteId: saved.id },
            replace: true,
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        applyApiError(error, fieldNames(getValues('lines').length), setError);
        // The form has no customer box for the server's customerId to sit under (15d.3): an
        // archived customer is said above the form, with what to do
        if (
          error instanceof ApiRequestError &&
          error.problem.fieldErrors?.customerId?.includes('sales_customer_invalid')
        ) {
          setError('root.server', { message: t('creditNotes.customerArchived') });
        }
      }
    });

  const removeDraft = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (draft: CreditNote) =>
      call(routes.creditNotes.remove, {
        params: { id: draft.id },
        query: { version: draft.version },
      }),
    onSuccess: async () => {
      await refresh();
      toast(t('creditNotes.deleted'));
      void navigate({ to: '/credit-notes' });
    },
  });

  const failure = errors.root?.server?.message ?? failureOf(removeDraft.error);

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <SalesBackLink to="/credit-notes" label={t('creditNotes.back')} />
      <PageHeader
        title={creditNote ? t('creditNotes.draftTitle') : t('creditNotes.newTitle')}
        description={t('creditNotes.description')}
      />
      <form
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(event) => void save(false)(event)}
        className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5"
      >
        {failure && <FormAlert message={failure} />}
        {/* Decision 6: a warning, not a block — saving and posting stay open */}
        {late && (
          <DocumentNotice tone="warn">
            {t('creditNotes.lateNotice', {
              number: invoice.number ?? '',
              date: isoDate(invoice.date),
            })}
          </DocumentNotice>
        )}
        <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-x-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <Field
            id="credit-note-customer"
            label={t('creditNotes.customer')}
            hint={locked ? t('creditNotes.invoiceLocked') : undefined}
          >
            <Suspense fallback={<Input id="credit-note-customer" icon={UserIcon} disabled />}>
              <CustomerPicker
                id="credit-note-customer"
                value={customerId}
                saved={savedCustomer}
                disabled={locked}
                onChange={(next) => {
                  setCustomerId(next);
                  // Another customer's invoice is not this one's to credit
                  setValue('invoiceId', '');
                }}
              />
            </Suspense>
          </Field>
          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            {/* Controlled, not registered: the options come from a query that answers after the
                form already holds its invoice (a credit note started from a return or an
                invoice). A registered select would keep showing the placeholder. */}
            <Controller
              control={control}
              name="invoiceId"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <SelectField
                  {...field}
                  label={t('creditNotes.invoice')}
                  hint={invoiceHint}
                  options={invoiceOptions}
                  disabled={customerId === '' || locked}
                  error={errors.invoiceId?.message}
                />
              )}
            />
          </div>
          <FormField control={control} name="date" label={t('creditNotes.date')}>
            {(field) => (
              <Suspense fallback={<Input id={field.id} icon={Calendar03Icon} disabled />}>
                <DatePicker {...field} />
              </Suspense>
            )}
          </FormField>
          <SelectField
            label={t('creditNotes.reason')}
            options={CREDIT_NOTE_REASONS.map((reason) => ({
              value: reason,
              label: t(creditReasonKey(reason)),
            }))}
            {...register('reason')}
            error={errors.reason?.message}
          />
          <div className="sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3">
            <TextField
              label={t('creditNotes.note')}
              optional
              placeholder={t('creditNotes.notePlaceholder')}
              {...register('note')}
              error={errors.note?.message}
            />
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Controller
          control={control}
          name="lines"
          render={({ field }) => (
            <Suspense fallback={<Card className="min-h-24" />}>
              <CreditNoteLinesEditor
                lines={field.value}
                onChange={field.onChange}
                getLines={() => getValues('lines')}
                invoice={invoice}
                customerId={customerId}
                returnNumbers={returnNumbers}
                onReturnNumbers={(entries) => {
                  setReturnNumbers((before) => new Map([...before, ...entries]));
                }}
                errors={errors.lines}
              />
            </Suspense>
          )}
        />

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
          {creditNote && (
            <div className="mr-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                disabled={removeDraft.isPending}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (confirming) removeDraft.mutate(creditNote);
                  else setConfirming(true);
                }}
              >
                <HugeiconsIcon icon={Delete02Icon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
                {confirming ? t('creditNotes.confirmDelete') : t('creditNotes.deleteDraft')}
              </Button>
              {confirming && (
                <span className="text-body-sm text-ink-2">{t('creditNotes.deleteWarning')}</span>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" disabled={isSubmitting}>
            {t('creditNotes.saveDraft')}
          </Button>
          <Button disabled={isSubmitting || lines.length === 0} onClick={() => void save(true)()}>
            {isSubmitting ? t('creditNotes.posting') : t('creditNotes.post')}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <p className="text-right text-label text-ink-3">{t('creditNotes.postHint')}</p>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **The customer box is not a form field.** The API takes the customer from the invoice (15d.1); the box only
  narrows the invoice select to that customer's posted invoices. It is a plain `Field`, and its value lives in state.
- **The invoice select** shows each invoice with its date and total ("INV-… · 23 Sep 2026 · ৳2,534.60"), so the
  person finds the right one among a customer's many. A draft keeps its own invoice in the list even when it is
  older than the 100 the select reads.
- **The invoice select is controlled** (a `Controller`, like the refund form's source select), not registered. Its
  options come from a query that answers after the form already holds the invoice (a credit note started from a
  return or from an invoice), and a registered `<select>` takes its value only once, when it mounts: it kept showing
  "Pick a posted invoice". The 15d.7 tests found this; the code here is the fixed one.
- **Both boxes lock while lines are on the form** (`invoiceLocked`). The lines belong to the invoice; under another
  invoice the server would refuse every one (`credit_note_line_invalid`). Changing the customer also empties the
  invoice.
- **The 6-month notice** (decision 6) is a `warn` document notice, shown when `creditNoteIsLate()` is true for the
  chosen invoice and date. It names the invoice and its date, and saving and posting stay open.
- **The reason starts as "Price cut"**, or "Goods came back" when the form starts from a return. A credit note
  without returned goods is most often a price cut.
- **An archived customer is said above the form.** Posting answers `sales_customer_invalid` under `customerId`
  (15d.3), a field this form does not have, so `applyApiError()` would only show the general code. The form puts
  `creditNotes.customerArchived` there instead: it says to restore the customer first.
- **The lines editor, the customer box and the date box are lazy chunks**, like the invoice form's.

```tsx
import { MoneySend02Icon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  contractErrorMap,
  type CreditNote,
  creditNoteAllocationsInputSchema,
  isZeroMoney,
  routes,
  subtractMoney,
  unappliedOf,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { Button, Card, cn, Dialog, PageHeader } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { Link, useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense, useState } from 'react';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { creditReasonKey } from '../lib/returns';
import { Fact } from './adjustment-view';
import { EntryLinks } from './entry-links';
import { CreditNotePrint, PrintButton } from './print-documents';
import { SalesLinesTable } from './sales-lines-table';
import {
  CustomerLink,
  DocumentNotice,
  LINK_NUMBER,
  LINK_ROW,
  LinkList,
  SalesBackLink,
} from './sales-parts';
import { DocumentStatusPill } from './sales-pills';
import { useIsoDate } from './stock-parts';

// "Apply money" is the receipt's dialog (money-dialogs.tsx), loaded when it opens
const ApplyForm = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./money-dialogs')).ApplyForm }));

// The credit note's own error codes for "Apply money"
const allocationsResolver = zodResolver(creditNoteAllocationsInputSchema, {
  error: contractErrorMap,
});

const LINK = 'font-medium text-brand underline-offset-3 hover:underline';

// A posted credit note (or a draft for someone who may not write them), read only. A posted one
// never changes (15d.1: no void). Where its money went can: "Apply money" moves it over the
// customer's invoices, and "Pay back" hands what is left to the customer with a refund.
export function CreditNoteView({ creditNote }: { creditNote: CreditNote }) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const can = useCan();
  const canWrite = can('sales.credit_note.manage');
  const canRefund = can('sales.refund.manage');
  const [applying, setApplying] = useState(false);
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });
  const posted = creditNote.status === 'posted';
  const unapplied = unappliedOf({
    amount: creditNote.total,
    applied: creditNote.applied,
    refunded: creditNote.refunded,
  });

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <SalesBackLink to="/credit-notes" label={t('creditNotes.back')} />
      <PageHeader
        title={creditNote.number ?? t('creditNotes.draftTitle')}
        description={creditNote.customer.name}
        actions={
          <>
            <DocumentStatusPill
              status={creditNote.status}
              label={t(`creditNotes.statuses.${creditNote.status}`)}
            />
            {posted && <PrintButton />}
          </>
        }
      />
      {posted && !isZeroMoney(unapplied) && (
        <DocumentNotice tone="neutral">
          {t('creditNotes.unappliedNotice', { amount: money(unapplied) })}
        </DocumentNotice>
      )}
      <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-4 p-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-0.5">
          <span className="text-caption font-medium text-ink-3">{t('creditNotes.customer')}</span>
          <span className="text-body-sm">
            <CustomerLink customer={creditNote.customer} />
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-0.5">
          <span className="text-caption font-medium text-ink-3">{t('creditNotes.invoice')}</span>
          <Link
            to="/invoices/$invoiceId"
            params={{ invoiceId: creditNote.invoice.id }}
            className={cn('font-mono text-body-sm tabular-nums', LINK)}
          >
            {creditNote.invoice.number}
          </Link>
          <span className="text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
            {isoDate(creditNote.invoice.date)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <Fact label={t('creditNotes.date')} value={isoDate(creditNote.date)} />
        <Fact label={t('creditNotes.reason')} value={t(creditReasonKey(creditNote.reason))} />
        {posted && (
          <>
            <Fact label={t('creditNotes.applied')} value={money(creditNote.applied)} />
            {!isZeroMoney(creditNote.refunded) && (
              <Fact label={t('creditNotes.refunded')} value={money(creditNote.refunded)} />
            )}
          </>
        )}
        {creditNote.postedAt !== null && (
          <Fact
            label={t('creditNotes.statuses.posted')}
            // A moment, not a date: shown in the reader's own time zone
            value={t('creditNotes.postedOn', { date: format.date(new Date(creditNote.postedAt)) })}
          />
        )}
        {posted && (
          <EntryLinks
            label={t('creditNotes.entry')}
            entries={creditNote.entry ? [creditNote.entry] : []}
            none={t('creditNotes.noEntry')}
          />
        )}
        {creditNote.note !== null && (
          <div className="sm:col-span-3">
            <Fact label={t('creditNotes.note')} value={creditNote.note} />
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
      <SalesLinesTable
        lines={creditNote.lines}
        totals={creditNote}
        pricesIncludeVat={creditNote.pricesIncludeVat}
        note={(line) =>
          line.returnNumber !== null && (
            <span className="text-caption text-ink-3">
              {t('creditNotes.fromReturn', { number: line.returnNumber })}
            </span>
          )
        }
      />

      {posted && (
        <LinkList
          title={t('creditNotes.invoicesTitle')}
          empty={creditNote.allocations.length === 0 ? t('creditNotes.noAllocations') : undefined}
        >
          {creditNote.allocations.map((allocation) => (
            <li key={allocation.invoiceId}>
              <Link
                to="/invoices/$invoiceId"
                params={{ invoiceId: allocation.invoiceId }}
                className={LINK_ROW}
              >
                <span className={LINK_NUMBER}>{allocation.invoiceNumber}</span>
                <span className="text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                  {t('invoices.dueOn', { date: isoDate(allocation.dueDate) })}
                </span>
                <span className="ml-auto font-medium tabular-nums">{money(allocation.amount)}</span>
              </Link>
            </li>
          ))}
        </LinkList>
      )}

      {posted && (canWrite || canRefund) && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
          {canRefund && !isZeroMoney(unapplied) && (
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() =>
                void navigate({ to: '/refunds/new', search: { creditNoteId: creditNote.id } })
              }
            >
              <HugeiconsIcon icon={MoneySend02Icon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
              {t('creditNotes.refund')}
            </Button>
          )}
          {canWrite && (
            <Button
              onClick={() => {
                setApplying(true);
              }}
            >
              {t('creditNotes.apply')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <Dialog open={applying} onOpenChange={setApplying}>
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          {applying && (
            <ApplyForm
              title={t('creditNotes.applyDialogTitle', { number: creditNote.number ?? '' })}
              customerId={creditNote.customer.id}
              // What refunds paid back cannot go on an invoice too (credit_note_over_allocated)
              amount={subtractMoney(creditNote.total, creditNote.refunded)}
              version={creditNote.version}
              allocations={creditNote.allocations}
              resolver={allocationsResolver}
              save={async (body) => {
                const saved = await call(routes.creditNotes.allocate, {
                  params: { id: creditNote.id },
                  body,
                });
                return t('creditNotes.allocated', { number: saved.number ?? '' });
              }}
              onDone={() => {
                setApplying(false);
              }}
            />
          )}
        </Suspense>
      </Dialog>
      {posted && <CreditNotePrint creditNote={creditNote} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **The invoice it takes back** links to it, with its date under the number: the person checks the 6 months at a
  glance.
- **Applied and paid back** show once posted, and the notice says how much is still the customer's advance, with
  what to do (apply it, or pay it back). It reads `unappliedOf()` with the credit note's total as the amount.
- **The lines say which return they give money back for** (`note` on `SalesLinesTable`).
- **"Apply money" is the receipt's dialog** with the credit note's own resolver and route, capped at the total less
  what refunds paid back.
- **"Pay back"** opens a refund from this credit note (`?creditNoteId=`), for `sales.refund.manage`, while money is
  left.
- **No void** (15d.1): a posted credit note never changes, so the page offers none.

```tsx
import { AlertCircleIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import type { Invoice, SalesReturn } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { EmptyState } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useParams, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';

import type { CreditNoteStart } from '../components/credit-note-form';
import { SalesBackLink } from '../components/sales-parts';
import { useTenantId, useToday } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { creditNoteQuery, invoiceQuery, salesReturnQuery, unitsQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { creditableReturnLines, firstCreditableInvoice, returnLineToCredit } from '../lib/returns';

// The page loads the data and picks the form or the view, each a lazy chunk of its own
const CreditNoteForm = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/credit-note-form')).CreditNoteForm,
}));
const CreditNoteView = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/credit-note-view')).CreditNoteView,
}));

function CantFind({ message }: { message: string }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <SalesBackLink to="/credit-notes" label={t('creditNotes.back')} />
      <EmptyState icon={AlertCircleIcon} title={t('creditNotes.title')} description={message} />
    </div>
  );
}

// What a new credit note starts with. Only a posted invoice can be credited; a draft (or a return
// with nothing left to credit) starts the form empty.
function startOf(
  invoice: Invoice | undefined,
  salesReturn: SalesReturn | undefined,
): CreditNoteStart | null {
  if (invoice?.status !== 'posted') return null;
  if (!salesReturn) {
    return { invoice, lines: [], returnNumbers: [], reason: 'price_adjustment' };
  }
  const invoiceLines = new Map(invoice.lines.map((line) => [line.id, line]));
  const lines = creditableReturnLines(salesReturn, invoice.id, new Set()).flatMap((line) => {
    const source = invoiceLines.get(line.invoiceLineId ?? '');
    return source ? [returnLineToCredit(line, source)] : [];
  });
  return {
    invoice,
    lines,
    returnNumbers: lines.map((line) => [line.returnLineId ?? '', salesReturn.number ?? '']),
    reason: 'goods_returned',
  };
}

// A new credit note. "Write credit note" on an invoice comes with ?invoiceId=; on a return with
// ?returnId=, and then the invoice is the first one that billed goods of the return not credited
// yet, and the form starts with those goods at that invoice's prices.
export function NewCreditNotePage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const canWrite = useCan()('sales.credit_note.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const units = useQuery(unitsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const { invoiceId = '', returnId = '' } = useSearch({ strict: false });
  const salesReturn = useQuery({
    ...salesReturnQuery(tenantId, returnId),
    enabled: returnId !== '',
  });
  const fromReturn = salesReturn.data ? firstCreditableInvoice(salesReturn.data) : null;
  const startId = returnId === '' ? invoiceId : (fromReturn ?? '');
  const invoice = useQuery({ ...invoiceQuery(tenantId, startId), enabled: startId !== '' });
  if (!canWrite) {
    return (
      <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
        <SalesBackLink to="/credit-notes" label={t('creditNotes.back')} />
        <p className="text-body-sm text-ink-3">{t('creditNotes.cantWrite')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (salesReturn.isError) return <CantFind message={t('salesReturns.notFound')} />;
  if (invoice.isError) return <CantFind message={t('invoices.notFound')} />;
  // The form waits for its start: drawing it empty and filling it a moment later would let the
  // person type into a form that is about to be replaced
  if (!units || (returnId !== '' && !salesReturn.data) || (startId !== '' && !invoice.data)) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <CreditNoteForm
        creditNote={null}
        start={startOf(invoice.data, salesReturn.data)}
        today={today}
      />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

export function CreditNotePage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const { creditNoteId = '' } = useParams({ strict: false });
  const canWrite = useCan()('sales.credit_note.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const units = useQuery(unitsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const { data: creditNote, isError } = useQuery({
    ...creditNoteQuery(tenantId, creditNoteId),
    enabled: creditNoteId !== '',
  });

  if (isError) return <CantFind message={t('creditNotes.notFound')} />;
  if (!creditNote || !units) return null;
  if (creditNote.status === 'draft' && canWrite) {
    // key: a saved draft comes back with a new version, and the form starts from it again
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        <CreditNoteForm
          key={`${creditNote.id}-${String(creditNote.version)}`}
          creditNote={creditNote}
          start={null}
          today={today}
        />
      </Suspense>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <CreditNoteView creditNote={creditNote} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

- **`startOf()` builds what a new credit note starts with**, outside the component so it is plain code:
  - From an invoice (`?invoiceId=`): that invoice, no lines, "Price cut".
  - From a return (`?returnId=`): `firstCreditableInvoice()` of the return, its goods on that invoice at the invoice's
    prices, "Goods came back", and the return's number for each line.
  - Only a posted invoice: a draft has nothing to take back, and the form then starts empty.
- **The form waits for the return and the invoice** before drawing, like the other forms.
