### Refunds: `refund-form.tsx`, `refund-view.tsx` and their routes (new)

```tsx
import { Calendar03Icon, UserIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  contractErrorMap,
  moneyAccountIds,
  type PartyRef,
  PAYMENT_METHODS,
  plainQuantity,
  refundInputSchema,
  type RefundFormValues,
  routes,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  FormAlert,
  FormField,
  Input,
  MoneyInput,
  PageHeader,
  SelectField,
  TextField,
  toast,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense, useMemo } from 'react';
import { type Path, useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { applyApiError } from '../lib/field-errors';
import { accountsQuery, branchesQuery, refundSourcesQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import {
  refundSourcesOf,
  type RefundSourceOption,
  sourceFields,
  sourceKeyOf,
} from '../lib/returns';
import { SalesBackLink, useSalesRefresh } from './sales-parts';
import { useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// The refund form (step 15d): its own chunk, loaded by routes/refund.tsx. Like a money receipt,
// a refund is never a draft: saving it posts it, so there is only this form for a new one.

// Both bring the popover; the delivery form says why that matters for the chunk
const CustomerPicker = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('./customer-picker')).CustomerPicker,
}));
const DatePicker = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./date-input')).DatePicker }));

type FormValues = RefundFormValues;

const FIELD_NAMES: Path<FormValues>[] = [
  'customerId',
  'date',
  'amount',
  'accountId',
  'method',
  'reference',
  'branchId',
  'note',
  'receiptId',
  'creditNoteId',
];

export function RefundForm({
  customer: startCustomer,
  source: startSource,
  today,
}: {
  // "Pay back" on a receipt or a credit note: its customer, and it as the source
  customer: PartyRef | null;
  source: RefundSourceOption | null;
  today: string;
}) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const refresh = useSalesRefresh();
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data ?? [];
  // The accounts money leaves from: the contracts' own list, the one the API checks against
  const moneyAccounts = useMemo(() => {
    const all = accounts ?? [];
    const ids = moneyAccountIds(all);
    return all
      .filter((account) => ids.has(account.id))
      .toSorted((a, b) => a.code.localeCompare(b.code, undefined, { numeric: true }));
  }, [accounts]);
  // The source's branch, when it is still active; otherwise the only branch, or none
  const branchOf = (source: RefundSourceOption | null): string =>
    source !== null && branches.some((branch) => branch.id === source.branchId)
      ? source.branchId
      : branches.length === 1
        ? (branches[0]?.id ?? '')
        : '';
  const {
    register,
    control,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    setValue,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(refundInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: {
      customerId: startCustomer?.id ?? '',
      date: today,
      amount: startSource ? plainQuantity(startSource.left) : '',
      // One cash box or bank account needs no choice
      accountId: moneyAccounts.length === 1 ? (moneyAccounts[0]?.id ?? '') : '',
      method: 'cash',
      reference: '',
      branchId: branchOf(startSource),
      note: '',
      ...(startSource ? sourceFields(sourceKeyOf(startSource)) : sourceFields('')),
    },
  });
  const customerId = useWatch({ control, name: 'customerId' });
  const method = useWatch({ control, name: 'method' });
  const receiptId = useWatch({ control, name: 'receiptId' }) ?? '';
  const creditNoteId = useWatch({ control, name: 'creditNoteId' }) ?? '';
  const { data: found } = useQuery({
    ...refundSourcesQuery(tenantId, customerId),
    enabled: customerId !== '',
    select: (lists) => refundSourcesOf(lists.receipts, lists.creditNotes),
  });
  // The customer's sources with money left, and the one the form started from when the list did
  // not read that far back (it reads the newest 100 of each)
  const sources = [
    ...(found ?? []),
    ...(startSource !== null &&
    customerId === startCustomer?.id &&
    !(found ?? []).some((source) => source.id === startSource.id)
      ? [startSource]
      : []),
  ];
  const chosenKey =
    receiptId !== ''
      ? sourceKeyOf({ type: 'receipt', id: receiptId })
      : creditNoteId !== ''
        ? sourceKeyOf({ type: 'credit_note', id: creditNoteId })
        : '';
  const chosen = sources.find((source) => sourceKeyOf(source) === chosenKey) ?? null;
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });

  // Another source: its two boxes, what it has left as the amount, and its branch
  const changeSource = (key: string) => {
    const fields = sourceFields(key);
    setValue('receiptId', fields.receiptId, { shouldValidate: errors.receiptId !== undefined });
    setValue('creditNoteId', fields.creditNoteId);
    const picked = sources.find((source) => sourceKeyOf(source) === key);
    if (!picked) return;
    setValue('amount', plainQuantity(picked.left));
    setValue('branchId', branchOf(picked));
  };

  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    try {
      const saved = await call(routes.refunds.create, { body: values });
      await refresh();
      toast(t('refunds.saved', { number: saved.number }));
      void navigate({ to: '/refunds/$refundId', params: { refundId: saved.id }, replace: true });
    } catch (error) {
      applyApiError(error, FIELD_NAMES, setError);
    }
  });

  const failure = errors.root?.server?.message;
  // Neither or both (refund_source), or not this customer's: the contract puts it on receiptId
  const sourceError = errors.receiptId?.message ?? errors.creditNoteId?.message;

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <SalesBackLink to="/refunds" label={t('refunds.back')} />
      <PageHeader title={t('refunds.newTitle')} description={t('refunds.description')} />
      <form
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(event) => void onSubmit(event)}
        className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5"
      >
        {failure && <FormAlert message={failure} />}
        <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-x-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <FormField control={control} name="customerId" label={t('refunds.customer')}>
            {(field) => (
              <Suspense fallback={<Input id={field.id} icon={UserIcon} disabled />}>
                <CustomerPicker
                  {...field}
                  saved={startCustomer}
                  onChange={(next) => {
                    setValue('customerId', next, {
                      shouldValidate: errors.customerId !== undefined,
                    });
                    // Another customer's money is not this one's to pay back
                    changeSource('');
                  }}
                />
              </Suspense>
            )}
          </FormField>
          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <SelectField
              label={t('refunds.source')}
              hint={
                customerId === ''
                  ? t('refunds.pickCustomer')
                  : found !== undefined && sources.length === 0
                    ? t('refunds.noSources')
                    : t('refunds.sourceHint')
              }
              disabled={customerId === '' || sources.length === 0}
              options={[
                { value: '', label: t('refunds.sourcePlaceholder') },
                ...sources.map((source) => ({
                  value: sourceKeyOf(source),
                  label: `${t(`refunds.sources.${source.type}`)} ${t('refunds.sourceOption', {
                    number: source.number,
                    amount: money(source.left),
                  })}`,
                })),
              ]}
              value={chosenKey}
              onChange={(event) => {
                changeSource(event.target.value);
              }}
              error={sourceError}
            />
          </div>
          <FormField
            control={control}
            name="amount"
            label={t('refunds.amount')}
            hint={
              chosen
                ? t('refunds.amountHint', { amount: money(chosen.left), number: chosen.number })
                : undefined
            }
          >
            {(field) => <MoneyInput {...field} />}
          </FormField>
          <FormField control={control} name="date" label={t('refunds.date')}>
            {(field) => (
              <Suspense fallback={<Input id={field.id} icon={Calendar03Icon} disabled />}>
                <DatePicker {...field} />
              </Suspense>
            )}
          </FormField>
          <SelectField
            label={t('refunds.account')}
            hint={moneyAccounts.length === 0 ? t('receipts.noAccounts') : t('refunds.accountHint')}
            disabled={moneyAccounts.length === 0}
            options={[
              { value: '', label: t('refunds.accountPlaceholder') },
              ...moneyAccounts.map((account) => ({
                value: account.id,
                label: `${account.code} · ${account.name}`,
              })),
            ]}
            {...register('accountId')}
            error={errors.accountId?.message}
          />
          <SelectField
            label={t('refunds.method')}
            options={PAYMENT_METHODS.map((value) => ({
              value,
              label: t(`receipts.methods.${value}`),
            }))}
            {...register('method')}
            error={errors.method?.message}
          />
          <TextField
            label={t('refunds.reference')}
            optional
            // How this kind of payment out is usually written down
            placeholder={t(`refunds.referencePlaceholders.${method}`)}
            {...register('reference')}
            error={errors.reference?.message}
          />
          <SelectField
            label={t('refunds.branch')}
            options={[
              { value: '', label: t('refunds.branch') },
              ...branches.map((branch) => ({ value: branch.id, label: branch.name })),
            ]}
            {...register('branchId')}
            error={errors.branchId?.message}
          />
          <div className="sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3">
            <TextField
              label={t('refunds.note')}
              optional
              placeholder={t('refunds.notePlaceholder')}
              {...register('note')}
              error={errors.note?.message}
            />
          </div>
        </Card>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>
            {isSubmitting ? t('refunds.saving') : t('refunds.save')}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <p className="text-right text-label text-ink-3">{t('refunds.saveHint')}</p>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **No draft**, like a receipt: saving posts it, and the hint says so.
- **One select for the source** (see `sourceKeyOf()`): "Money receipt MR-… · ৳1,500.00 left". Picking one fills the
  amount with what is left and the branch with the source's, so the cashier usually only checks and saves. The hint
  under the amount repeats the cap, so `refund_over_source` is rare.
- **The source the form started from stays in the list** even when it is older than the 100 receipts and credit
  notes the select reads: "Pay back" on an old receipt must still work.
- **The source's errors show under the select.** The contract puts "pick one" (`refund_source`) on `receiptId`, and
  the server may answer on either box; both are one select on the screen.
- **"Paid from"** offers the money accounts of `moneyAccountIds()`, the receipt form's list.
- **Another customer empties the source**: another customer's advance is not this one's to pay back.

```tsx
import { type Refund, routes } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { Button, Card, cn, Dialog, PageHeader } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Link } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense, useState } from 'react';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { accountsQuery, branchesQuery } from '../lib/queries';
import { Fact } from './adjustment-view';
import { EntryLinks } from './entry-links';
import { PrintButton, RefundPrint } from './print-documents';
import { CustomerLink, DocumentNotice, SalesBackLink } from './sales-parts';
import { DocumentStatusPill } from './sales-pills';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId } from './stock-parts';

// "Void refund" is the receipt's void dialog (money-dialogs.tsx), loaded when it opens
const VoidForm = lazy(async () => ({ default: (await import('./money-dialogs')).VoidForm }));

const LINK = 'font-medium text-brand underline-offset-3 hover:underline';

// A saved refund, read only: it is posted the moment it is saved. Money that never reached the
// customer (a cheque that came back) is undone by "Void refund": its entry is reversed and the
// money is the source's advance again. A voided one stays in the list with its number.
export function RefundView({ refund, today }: { refund: Refund; today: string }) {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data;
  const canWrite = useCan()('sales.refund.manage');
  const [voiding, setVoiding] = useState(false);
  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });
  const posted = refund.status === 'posted';
  const account = accounts?.find((item) => item.id === refund.accountId);
  const sourceLabel = `${t(`refunds.sources.${refund.source.type}`)} ${refund.source.number}`;

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <SalesBackLink to="/refunds" label={t('refunds.back')} />
      <PageHeader
        title={refund.number}
        description={refund.customer.name}
        actions={
          <>
            <DocumentStatusPill
              status={refund.status}
              label={t(`refunds.statuses.${refund.status}`)}
            />
            {/* A voided refund does not print: on paper it would look like money handed over */}
            {posted && <PrintButton />}
          </>
        }
      />
      {refund.voidDate !== null && (
        <DocumentNotice tone="neutral">
          {t('refunds.voidedNotice', {
            date: isoDate(refund.voidDate),
            reason: refund.voidReason ?? '',
          })}
        </DocumentNotice>
      )}
      <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-4 p-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-0.5">
          <span className="text-caption font-medium text-ink-3">{t('refunds.customer')}</span>
          <span className="text-body-sm">
            <CustomerLink customer={refund.customer} />
          </span>
        </div>
        <Fact label={t('refunds.date')} value={isoDate(refund.date)} />
        <Fact label={t('refunds.amount')} value={money(refund.amount)} />
        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-0.5">
          <span className="text-caption font-medium text-ink-3">{t('refunds.source')}</span>
          {refund.source.type === 'receipt' ? (
            <Link
              to="/receipts/$receiptId"
              params={{ receiptId: refund.source.id }}
              className={cn('text-body-sm', LINK)}
            >
              {sourceLabel}
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <Link
              to="/credit-notes/$creditNoteId"
              params={{ creditNoteId: refund.source.id }}
              className={cn('text-body-sm', LINK)}
            >
              {sourceLabel}
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>
        <Fact label={t('refunds.method')} value={t(`receipts.methods.${refund.method}`)} />
        {refund.reference !== null && (
          <Fact label={t('refunds.reference')} value={refund.reference} />
        )}
        <Fact
          label={t('refunds.account')}
          value={account ? `${account.code} · ${account.name}` : '—'}
        />
        <Fact
          label={t('refunds.branch')}
          value={branches?.find((branch) => branch.id === refund.branchId)?.name ?? '—'}
        />
        <EntryLinks label={t('refunds.entry')} entries={[refund.entry]} none="" />
        {refund.voidEntry !== null && (
          <EntryLinks label={t('refunds.voidEntry')} entries={[refund.voidEntry]} none="" />
        )}
        {refund.note !== null && (
          <div className="sm:col-span-3">
            <Fact label={t('refunds.note')} value={refund.note} />
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      {posted && canWrite && (
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={() => {
              setVoiding(true);
            }}
          >
            {t('refunds.void')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      <Dialog open={voiding} onOpenChange={setVoiding}>
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          {voiding && (
            <VoidForm
              words="refunds"
              number={refund.number}
              version={refund.version}
              today={today}
              save={async (body) => {
                await call(routes.refunds.void, { params: { id: refund.id }, body });
              }}
              onDone={() => {
                setVoiding(false);
              }}
            />
          )}
        </Suspense>
      </Dialog>
      {posted && <RefundPrint refund={refund} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **The source links to its receipt or credit note**, the place to see the rest of that money.
- **"Void refund"** uses the shared dialog with the refund's words. It is the page's only action, so it sits alone on
  the right.
- **A voided refund does not print**: on paper it would look like money handed over.

```tsx
import { AlertCircleIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import {
  compareMoney,
  type CreditNote,
  type PartyRef,
  type Receipt,
  unappliedOf,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { EmptyState } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useParams, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';

import { SalesBackLink } from '../components/sales-parts';
import { useTenantId, useToday } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import {
  accountsQuery,
  branchesQuery,
  creditNoteQuery,
  receiptQuery,
  refundQuery,
} from '../lib/queries';
import type { RefundSourceOption } from '../lib/returns';

const RefundForm = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/refund-form')).RefundForm,
}));
const RefundView = lazy(async () => ({
  default: (await import('../components/refund-view')).RefundView,
}));

// The chart (for the money accounts) and the branches: the form's defaults are worked out from
// them once, as it opens
function useReady(): boolean {
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const branches = useQuery(branchesQuery(tenantId, 'active')).data;
  return accounts !== undefined && branches !== undefined;
}

function CantFind({ message }: { message: string }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <SalesBackLink to="/refunds" label={t('refunds.back')} />
      <EmptyState icon={AlertCircleIcon} title={t('refunds.title')} description={message} />
    </div>
  );
}

// "Pay back" on a receipt or a credit note: it as the form's source, while it is posted and has
// money left. Otherwise (voided, a draft, or used up since) the form starts with its customer
// alone: a source with nothing left would only fill the amount with ৳0.
function startOf(
  receipt: Receipt | undefined,
  creditNote: CreditNote | undefined,
): { customer: PartyRef | null; source: RefundSourceOption | null } {
  const usable = (source: RefundSourceOption, posted: boolean) =>
    posted && compareMoney(source.left, '0') > 0 ? source : null;
  if (receipt) {
    const source: RefundSourceOption = {
      type: 'receipt',
      id: receipt.id,
      number: receipt.number,
      date: receipt.date,
      branchId: receipt.branchId,
      left: unappliedOf(receipt),
    };
    return { customer: receipt.customer, source: usable(source, receipt.status === 'posted') };
  }
  if (creditNote) {
    const source: RefundSourceOption = {
      type: 'credit_note',
      id: creditNote.id,
      number: creditNote.number ?? '',
      date: creditNote.date,
      branchId: creditNote.branchId,
      left: unappliedOf({
        amount: creditNote.total,
        applied: creditNote.applied,
        refunded: creditNote.refunded,
      }),
    };
    return {
      customer: creditNote.customer,
      source: usable(source, creditNote.status === 'posted'),
    };
  }
  return { customer: null, source: null };
}

// A new refund. "Pay back" on a receipt comes with ?receiptId=, on a credit note with
// ?creditNoteId=.
export function NewRefundPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const tenantId = useTenantId();
  const canWrite = useCan()('sales.refund.manage');
  const today = useToday();
  const ready = useReady();
  const { receiptId = '', creditNoteId = '' } = useSearch({ strict: false });
  const receipt = useQuery({ ...receiptQuery(tenantId, receiptId), enabled: receiptId !== '' });
  const creditNote = useQuery({
    ...creditNoteQuery(tenantId, creditNoteId),
    enabled: creditNoteId !== '',
  });
  if (!canWrite) {
    return (
      <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
        <SalesBackLink to="/refunds" label={t('refunds.back')} />
        <p className="text-body-sm text-ink-3">{t('refunds.cantWrite')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (receipt.isError) return <CantFind message={t('receipts.notFound')} />;
  if (creditNote.isError) return <CantFind message={t('creditNotes.notFound')} />;
  if (!ready || (receiptId !== '' && !receipt.data) || (creditNoteId !== '' && !creditNote.data)) {
    return null;
  }
  const start = startOf(receipt.data, creditNote.data);
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <RefundForm customer={start.customer} source={start.source} today={today} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

export function RefundPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const { refundId = '' } = useParams({ strict: false });
  const today = useToday();
  const { data: refund, isError } = useQuery({
    ...refundQuery(useTenantId(), refundId),
    enabled: refundId !== '',
  });
  if (isError) return <CantFind message={t('refunds.notFound')} />;
  if (!refund) return null;
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <RefundView refund={refund} today={today} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

- **`startOf()`** starts the form from a receipt (`?receiptId=`) or a credit note (`?creditNoteId=`) only while it is
  posted and has money left. A link to "Pay back" can be old: the money may have been applied since, and a source
  with nothing left would only fill the amount with ৳0. Then the form starts with the customer alone.
- **`compareMoney()`, not a string compare**: "0.0000" and "0.00" are the same money.

```tsx
import { MoneySend02Icon, PlusSignIcon } from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons';
import { HugeiconsIcon } from '@hugeicons/react';
import { REFUND_STATUSES, type RefundStatus, type RefundSummary } from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import {
  Button,
  DataTable,
  dataTableColumns,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  SegmentedControl,
} from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useInfiniteQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { CustomerPicker } from '../components/customer-picker';
import { DocumentStatusPill } from '../components/sales-pills';
import { useIsoDate, useTenantId } from '../components/stock-parts';
import { useCan } from '../lib/permissions';
import { refundsQuery } from '../lib/queries';

const column = dataTableColumns<RefundSummary>();

// The refunds (step 15d): money paid back to customers, and where it was paid back from
export function RefundsPage() {
  const { t, format } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const canWrite = useCan()('sales.refund.manage');
  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<RefundStatus | ''>('');
  const [customerId, setCustomerId] = useState('');
  const { data, isError, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage } = useInfiniteQuery(
    refundsQuery(useTenantId(), { status, customerId }),
  );
  const rows = useMemo(() => data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.items), [data]);
  const loadMore = useCallback(() => {
    if (hasNextPage && !isFetchingNextPage) void fetchNextPage();
  }, [hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage]);

  const columns = useMemo(
    () =>
      column.columns([
        column.accessor('number', {
          header: t('refunds.columns.number'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'title' },
          cell: ({ row }) => (
            <span className="grid">
              <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums">{row.original.number}</span>
              <span className="text-caption text-ink-3 tabular-nums">
                {isoDate(row.original.date)}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor((refund) => refund.customer.name, {
          id: 'customer',
          header: t('refunds.columns.customer'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'subtitle' },
          cell: ({ row }) => (
            <span className="grid min-w-0 max-w-[18rem]">
              <span className="truncate">{row.original.customer.name}</span>
              <span className="truncate font-mono text-caption text-ink-3">
                {row.original.customer.code}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor('source', {
          header: t('refunds.columns.source'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'detail' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => (
            <span className="grid">
              <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{getValue().number}</span>
              <span className="text-caption text-ink-3">
                {t(`refunds.sources.${getValue().type}`)}
              </span>
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor('method', {
          header: t('refunds.columns.method'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'detail' },
          cell: ({ row, getValue }) => (
            <span className="grid min-w-0 max-w-[14rem]">
              <span>{t(`receipts.methods.${getValue()}`)}</span>
              {row.original.reference !== null && (
                <span className="truncate text-caption text-ink-3">{row.original.reference}</span>
              )}
            </span>
          ),
        }),
        column.accessor('amount', {
          header: t('refunds.columns.amount'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { align: 'end', card: 'detail' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => <span className="font-medium">{format.money(getValue())}</span>,
        }),
        column.accessor('status', {
          header: t('refunds.columns.status'),
          enableSorting: false,
          meta: { card: 'trailing' },
          cell: ({ getValue }) => (
            <DocumentStatusPill status={getValue()} label={t(`refunds.statuses.${getValue()}`)} />
          ),
        }),
      ]),
    [t, format, isoDate],
  );

  const write = canWrite && (
    <Button onClick={() => void navigate({ to: '/refunds/new' })}>
      <HugeiconsIcon icon={PlusSignIcon} size={17} strokeWidth={1.5} />
      {t('refunds.new')}
    </Button>
  );

  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-5">
      <PageHeader
        title={t('refunds.title')}
        description={t('refunds.description')}
        actions={write}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 basis-72">
          <CustomerPicker
            id="refunds-customer"
            aria-label={t('refunds.customer')}
            value={customerId}
            saved={null}
            onChange={setCustomerId}
            allLabel={t('customers.allCustomers')}
          />
        </div>
        <SegmentedControl
          label={t('refunds.show')}
          value={status}
          options={[
            { value: '', label: t('refunds.all') },
            ...REFUND_STATUSES.map((value) => ({
              value,
              label: t(`refunds.statuses.${value}`),
            })),
          ]}
          onChange={setStatus}
        />
      </div>
      {isError && <p className="text-body-sm text-crit">{t('refunds.loadFailed')}</p>}
      {rows && (
        <DataTable
          label={t('refunds.title')}
          data={rows}
          columns={columns}
          getRowId={(row) => row.id}
          onRowClick={(row) =>
            void navigate({ to: '/refunds/$refundId', params: { refundId: row.id } })
          }
          onEndReached={loadMore}
          empty={
            <EmptyState
              icon={MoneySend02Icon}
              title={t('refunds.emptyTitle')}
              description={t('refunds.emptyBody')}
              action={write}
            />
          }
          footer={
            isFetchingNextPage && (
              <p className="text-caption text-ink-3">{t('common.loadingMore')}</p>
            )
          }
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **The source and the method each show their own detail**: the number with its kind, and the reference (the cheque
  or TrxID) under the method, the way a cashier looks for a payment.

```diff
+// Step 15d: the return slip the store keeper signs when the goods come in: what came back, from
+// which challan, into which warehouse, and why. No prices: a credit note gives the money back.
+export function SalesReturnPrint({
+  salesReturn,
+  warehouse,
+}: {
+  salesReturn: SalesReturn;
+  warehouse: string;
+}) {
+  const { t } = useLocale();
+  const isoDate = useIsoDate();

+    <Sheet
+      title={t('print.titles.salesReturn')}
+      meta={[
+        { label: t('print.number'), value: salesReturn.number ?? '' },
+        { label: t('print.date'), value: isoDate(salesReturn.date) },
+        { label: t('print.reason'), value: t(returnReasonKey(salesReturn.reason)) },
+        { label: t('salesReturns.warehouse'), value: warehouse },
+      ]}
+      signatures={[
+        t('print.signatures.customer'),
+        t('print.signatures.receivedBy'),
+        t('print.signatures.authorised'),
+      ]}
+    >
+      <PartyBlock
+        label={t('print.customer')}
+        name={salesReturn.customer.name}
+        code={salesReturn.customer.code}
+      />
+      <StockPrintLines
+        lines={salesReturn.lines}
+        note={(line) =>
+          line.deliveryNumber === null ? null : `${t('print.challan')}: ${line.deliveryNumber}`
+        }
+      />
+      <Note note={salesReturn.note} />
+    </Sheet>
+  );
+}
+
+// Step 15d: the credit note, laid out like the invoice it takes back, with that invoice's number and
+// date at the top: the customer's accountant files it against the invoice
+export function CreditNotePrint({ creditNote }: { creditNote: CreditNote }) {
+  const { t } = useLocale();
+  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
+  return (
+    <Sheet
+      title={t('print.titles.creditNote')}
+      meta={[
+        { label: t('print.number'), value: creditNote.number ?? '' },
+        { label: t('print.date'), value: isoDate(creditNote.date) },
+        { label: t('print.originalInvoice'), value: creditNote.invoice.number },
+        { label: t('print.invoiceDate'), value: isoDate(creditNote.invoice.date) },
+        { label: t('print.reason'), value: t(creditReasonKey(creditNote.reason)) },
+      ]}
+      signatures={[t('print.signatures.preparedBy'), t('print.signatures.authorised')]}
+    >
+      <PartyBlock
+        label={t('print.billTo')}
+        name={creditNote.customer.name}
+        code={creditNote.customer.code}
+      />
+      <PricedLines
+        lines={creditNote.lines}
+        totals={creditNote}
+        pricesIncludeVat={creditNote.pricesIncludeVat}
+      />
+      <Note note={creditNote.note} />
+    </Sheet>
+  );
+}
+
+// Step 15d: the slip the customer signs when the money is handed back, the receipt's mirror
+export function RefundPrint({ refund }: { refund: Refund }) {
+  const { t, format } = useLocale();
+  const isoDate = useIsoDate();
+  const money = (value: string) => format.money(value, { decimals: 2 });
+  return (
+    <Sheet
+      title={t('print.titles.refund')}
+      meta={[
+        { label: t('print.number'), value: refund.number },
+        { label: t('print.date'), value: isoDate(refund.date) },
+      ]}
+      signatures={[t('print.signatures.customer'), t('print.signatures.authorised')]}
+    >
+      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
+        <PartyBlock
+          label={t('print.paidTo')}
+          name={refund.customer.name}
+          code={refund.customer.code}
+        />
+        <PrintBlock label={t('print.amountPaidBack')}>
+          <p className="text-h2 tabular-nums">{money(refund.amount)}</p>
+        </PrintBlock>
+        <PrintBlock label={t('print.paidBy')}>
+          <p>{t(`receipts.methods.${refund.method}`)}</p>
+        </PrintBlock>
+        {refund.reference !== null && (
+          <PrintBlock label={t('print.reference')}>
+            <p>{refund.reference}</p>
+          </PrintBlock>
+        )}
+        <PrintBlock label={t('print.paidBackFrom')}>
+          <p>
+            {t(`refunds.sources.${refund.source.type}`)}{' '}
+            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{refund.source.number}</span>
+          </p>
+        </PrintBlock>
+      </div>
+      <Note note={refund.note} />
+    </Sheet>
+  );
+}
```

- **`StockPrintLines`** is the challan's table, moved into a function of its own: the return prints the same lines.
  `note` adds a line under an item ("Challan: DC-…" on a return).
- **The sales return** prints like a challan: no prices, the reason and the warehouse in the head, and three
  signatures (the customer who handed the goods over, the store keeper who received them, and whoever approves).
  A credit note gives the money back, so a return slip with prices would look like a promise of money.
- **The credit note** prints like an invoice, with the original invoice's number and date in the head and the
  reason. The customer's accountant files it against that invoice, and the Mushak 6.7 (later) prints the same. A
  line that gives money back for returned goods says which return.
- **The refund** prints like a receipt, mirrored: paid to, amount paid back, how, and from which receipt or credit
  note. The customer signs it.
- **The invoice prints what credit notes took off** ("Credited") between "Paid" and "Due", which is now
  `amountDueOf()`: a printed statement must add up.
- **The receipt's "Kept as an advance" is `unappliedOf()`**: money paid back is no advance any more.

### Settings: `sales-accounts-card.tsx` (new), `routes/settings.tsx`

```tsx
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  type Account,
  contractErrorMap,
  routes,
  type SalesAccounts,
  updateSalesAccountsInputSchema,
} from '@omnivo/contracts';
import { useLocale } from '@omnivo/i18n';
import { Button, Card, CardHeader, FormAlert, SelectField, toast } from '@omnivo/ui';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';

import { call } from '../lib/api';
import { applyApiError } from '../lib/field-errors';
import { accountsQuery, salesAccountsQuery } from '../lib/queries';

// Settings → Sales, step 15d: the account a credit note takes the sale back from (decision 7). A
// card of its own, like the stock accounts of step 14: its own endpoint, its own save button.
export function SalesAccountsCard({
  tenantId,
  canManage,
}: {
  tenantId: string;
  canManage: boolean;
}) {
  const choices = useQuery(salesAccountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  const accounts = useQuery(accountsQuery(tenantId)).data;
  if (!choices || !accounts) return null;
  // key: a saved form comes back with the new choice, and starts from it again
  return (
    <SalesAccountsForm
      key={choices.returns ?? 'none'}
      tenantId={tenantId}
      choices={choices}
      accounts={accounts}
      canManage={canManage}
    />
  );
}

function SalesAccountsForm({
  tenantId,
  choices,
  accounts,
  canManage,
}: {
  tenantId: string;
  choices: SalesAccounts;
  accounts: readonly Account[];
  canManage: boolean;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setError,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting, isDirty },
  } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(updateSalesAccountsInputSchema, { error: contractErrorMap }),
    defaultValues: { returns: choices.returns ?? '' },
  });

  // Like the API (sales_account_invalid): an active income account that is not a group. The
  // current choice stays in the list even if it was archived since, so the select shows it instead
  // of silently moving to "None".
  const options = [
    { value: '', label: t('settings.salesReturnsAccountNone') },
    ...accounts
      .filter(
        (account) =>
          account.id === choices.returns ||
          (account.type === 'income' && !account.isGroup && account.archivedAt === null),
      )
      .toSorted((a, b) => a.code.localeCompare(b.code, undefined, { numeric: true }))
      .map((account) => ({ value: account.id, label: `${account.code} · ${account.name}` })),
  ];

  const save = handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    try {
      await call(routes.salesAccounts.update, { body: values });
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['sales-accounts', tenantId] });
      toast(t('settings.salesAccountsSaved'));
    } catch (error) {
      applyApiError(error, ['returns'], setError);
    }
  });

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={t('settings.salesAccountsTitle')}
        subtitle={t('settings.salesAccountsSubtitle')}
      />
      <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void save(event)} className="grid gap-5 p-5">
        {errors.root?.server?.message && <FormAlert message={errors.root.server.message} />}
        {/* Read only without core.settings.manage: everyone may see where returns are booked */}
        <fieldset disabled={!canManage} className="grid">
          <SelectField
            label={t('settings.salesReturnsAccount')}
            hint={t('settings.salesReturnsAccountHint')}
            options={options}
            {...register('returns')}
            error={errors.returns?.message}
          />
        </fieldset>
        {canManage && (
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" disabled={isSubmitting || !isDirty}>
              {isSubmitting ? t('common.saving') : t('settings.salesAccountsSave')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

- **A card of its own**, like the stock accounts of step 14: it saves through its own route (`PUT /sales-accounts`),
  with its own button and toast.
- **The select offers what the API accepts** (`sales_account_invalid`): active income accounts that are not groups.
  The current choice stays in the list even if it was archived since, so the select shows it instead of silently
  moving to "None".
- **The empty choice says what it means**: "None: take it off the Sales account itself" (decision 7). An empty box
  would look like a missing value.
- **Read only without `core.settings.manage`**: everyone may see where returns are booked; the fieldset is disabled
  and the button hidden.
- **The form's key is the saved choice**, so after a save the form starts again from the new value and "Save" turns
  off until the next change.

Every page that calls the API carries the contracts' `routes`, and 15d.1 made them bigger. Before this part, the
opening balances page was already at 100.6 KB, and the invoice and quotation lists close behind. Three changes
brought every chunk back under 100 KB:
- **The status pills moved to `sales-pills.tsx`** (see that section): a form no longer carries a dozen status icons.
  The receipt form went from 101.8 KB to 97.1 KB.
- **`refundSourcesOf()` runs in the refund form**, not in `lib/queries.ts` (see that section): 0.3 KB off every list.
- **The opening balances page loads the customer box and the date picker as chunks of their own**, the journal
  form's fix in 15c: both bring the popover (11 KB). The page went from 101.3 KB to 75.1 KB. Until the chunks
  arrive, each box is a disabled input with its icon.

The sales lists are now at 98.5–99.4 KB. The next step that grows the contracts will push them over; making their
customer filter a lazy chunk too frees about 13 KB each.

## 15d.7 — `apps/app`: the mock API and the end-to-end tests

`pnpm dev:mock` and the Playwright tests run the app on MSW, the fake API inside the browser (step 4). This part
teaches the mock sales returns, credit notes, refunds and the sales returns account, with the API's rules,
shortened. It also fixes the four mock type errors that 15d.6 left. Then three new test files click through the
screens of 15d.6 on a desktop and on a phone: take goods back from a challan, bill what is left of it, take back
expired strips into a damage store, give money back for goods that came back after billing, credit a whole invoice,
see the 6-month warning, apply a credit note's advance, pay an advance back and void the refund, and keep the sales
returns account.

This was the first time the 15d screens ran in a browser. The tests found two problems, both fixed in this part:

- **The credit note form showed "Pick a posted invoice" when it started from a return.** The invoice select was a
  registered `<select>`. Its options come from a query that answers after the form already holds the invoice, and a
  registered select only takes its value once, when it mounts. The select is now controlled (below, and in
  15d.6's prose).
- **On a laptop screen, the last sidebar links could not be reached on a long page.** The desktop sidebar is as tall
  as the screen and stays put while the page scrolls, but the navigation is about 2,000 px tall (15d.6 added three
  more links). On the chart of accounts, "Settings" sat below the screen with no way to scroll to it. The sidebar now
  scrolls on its own (`packages/ui`, below). This was older than 15d; the new links made it worse.

Decisions made while building this part (you were not asked):

- **Returns, credit notes and refunds live in their own file**, `mocks/return-data.ts`, and in a new `returns` field
  of the mock workspace, like 15c's `billing`. When an invoice, a receipt or a challan needs to know about them
  (what was credited, what was paid back, what came back), it reads `data.returns` through the `WorkspaceData` type
  only. The new file imports the invoice and sales files, so an import back would close a circle, which
  `pnpm boundaries` refuses (15c.7 explains why).
- **Every sum is worked out on read; only facts fixed at posting are stored.** What credit notes applied to an
  invoice, their totals, each invoice line's credited money, what a receipt or a credit note paid back, and what
  credit notes gave back for a return line are added up each time, like 15c's `amountPaid`. The API keeps these with
  counters and triggers (15d.2); in the mock they can then never disagree. Stored: a challan line's
  `returnedQuantity` (moved at posting, like 15c's `invoiced` flag on the same line), and a return line's invoice
  line (fixed at posting, like the API's).
- **The pharmacy gets a "Damage and expiry" store (DMG)** and **"4120 Sales returns"** in its chart, chosen as its
  sales returns account, like the API's pharmacy template (15d.3). The garments chart has no 4120, so a garments
  credit note takes the sale back from Export sales itself, as for a workspace that never chose an account.
- **The seeds post no return, credit note or refund.** All three write journal entries, and the journal, report and
  customer tests read the seeded books to the taka, as in 15b and 15c.
- **No end-to-end test of the read-only views** (a member without `core.settings.manage` sees the sales accounts
  card locked). The mock always signs in as the owner, who has every permission, as 15b.7 and 15c.7 said. The API's
  tests (15d.4) check the 403 answers.
- **Three long tests are marked `test.slow()`.** Each walks four documents or more (delivery, invoice, return and
  credit note), and on a phone-sized page under load they came close to Playwright's 30 seconds.

- **`returns` holds the three document lists and their three number counters.** `usedNumbers()` reads the counters,
  so the Numbering page shows the right "next number" for `sales.return`, `sales.credit_note` and `sales.refund`.
- **`salesAccounts` is a field of its own**, like `stockAccounts`: the setting is one value, not a document.
  `startFresh()` (the mock sign-up) clears it, because a new workspace has no chart until its setup job runs.
- **`transaction()` copies `returns` too.** Posting a return moves stock, challan lines and orders, and posting a
  credit note writes its allocation; a refused posting must leave none of it behind, number counters included.

  lines' `returnedQuantity`, and the list from the posted returns that name a line of this challan. A draft return

  not billed and not all of it came back. A challan whose last unbilled line came back in full is "Invoiced", like
  the API's `lineToInvoice`.
- **`returnable()` and `matchesReturnFilter()`** are the API's `?return=returnable`: posted, with a line that has not
  all come back. That is what the return form's "Add from challans" offers.

- **`deliveryAccounts()` is exported**: a return posts to the same inventory and cost of goods sold accounts, the
  other way round, and must refuse the same way when one is missing.


- **`salesDocumentsOf()` lists every document that names a customer**, the 15b and 15c ones plus the three new ones.
  Renaming a customer refreshes all of them, and a customer named on any of them cannot be deleted
  (`customer_in_use`, the API's three new foreign keys). One list for both, so a step that adds a document adds it
  once.
